Nền tảng Luyện thi & Phân tích tiếng Anh Thông minh

Lingua kết hợp giữa ngân hàng đề thi chuẩn khảo thí quốc tế (ETS TOEIC & Cambridge IELTS) cùng công nghệ trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) giúp tối ưu hóa thời gian và nâng cao band điểm một cách vượt bậc.

🎧

Đề thi Chuẩn Khảo Thí 4 Kỹ Năng

Bao gồm trọn bộ đề thi thật ETS TOEIC 2022-2024 và Cambridge IELTS 16-19. Listening đầy đủ 20-25 câu có audio player chỉnh tốc độ 1.25x; Reading phân đoạn rõ ràng; Speaking có đồng hồ bấm giờ chuẩn; Writing có bài mẫu Band 8.5.

🤖

Trợ Lý AI Phân Tích Đa Định Dạng

Hỗ trợ kéo thả các tệp PDF, Excel (.xlsx), Word (.docx) hoặc dán văn bản trực tiếp. AI tự động đo cấp độ chuẩn CEFR (B1 - C2), trích xuất Key Takeaways, Collocations học thuật và sinh trắc nghiệm tương tác tức thì.

📚

Sổ Tay Từ Vựng CEFR B1 - C2 & Custom

Hơn 126+ từ vựng phân loại theo chủ đề công sở, công nghệ, y tế, đời sống... Tích hợp thẻ Flashcard phát âm Web Speech chuẩn bản ngữ, thử thách trắc nghiệm phản xạ và chức năng tự nhập từ vựng cá nhân từ bàn phím.

📈

Lộ Trình Cá Nhân & Thống Kê Real-time

Khảo sát mục tiêu điểm số (TOEIC 500-990 / IELTS 5.0-8.5), tự động thiết kế lộ trình hàng ngày. Hệ thống lưu vết chi tiết từng bài thi, ngày giờ hoàn thành, số câu đúng/sai và biểu đồ tiến bộ điểm số trực quan.

Đưa lý do và ví dụ.', prepTime: 30, speakTime: 60, sampleAnswer: 'In my opinion, I strongly agree that remote work enhances overall employee productivity. Firstly, eliminating long daily commutes saves employees substantial energy and reduces morning stress, allowing them to start their workday refreshed. Secondly, working in a personalized home setting significantly minimizes office distractions, facilitating deep, uninterrupted focus. For example, in my previous software firm, team output increased by 20% after implementing flexible hybrid schedules.', ai_explain: 'Cần có quan điểm rõ ràng (Clear thesis), tối thiểu 2 luận điểm hỗ trợ mạnh mẽ (Supporting arguments), và ví dụ thực tế thuyết phục.' } ] }, 'TOEIC Writing · Email Reply & Opinion Essay': { type: 'writing', questions: [ { text: 'Task 1: Respond to a Customer Inquiry Email\\nDirections: Read the email from a customer complaining about a damaged product delivery. Write a professional reply of 80-120 words offering an apology, an explanation, and two concrete solutions (replacement or refund).', translated: 'Bài 1: Trả lời email khiếu nại của khách hàng về kiện hàng bị hư hại. Viết thư phản hồi 80-120 từ xin lỗi và đưa ra 2 hướng xử lý.', minWords: 80, sampleAnswer: 'Dear Mr. Davis,\\n\\nThank you for bringing this issue to our attention. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the damaged delivery of your porcelain tableware set.\\n\\nQuality assurance is our highest priority, and we have already initiated an investigation with our logistics carrier to prevent future occurrences. To resolve this matter immediately, we would be delighted to either dispatch an express replacement set to your address at no additional charge, or process a full refund to your original payment card within 24 hours.\\n\\nPlease let us know your preferred resolution.\\n\\nSincerely,\\nCustomer Support Team', ai_explain: 'Tiêu chí TOEIC Writing Email: Văn phong lịch sự, giải quyết đầy đủ các yêu cầu của đề bài, cấu trúc câu chặt chẽ và không có lỗi ngữ pháp cơ bản.' }, { text: 'Task 2: Write an Opinion Essay (minimum 200 words)\\nDirections: Some companies believe that team members should strictly dress in formal business attire, while others encourage casual clothing. Which approach do you support, and why?', translated: 'Bài 2: Viết luận nêu quan điểm (tối thiểu 200 từ) về trang phục công sở: Trang trọng (Formal) hay Thoải mái (Casual)?', minWords: 200, sampleAnswer: 'In modern corporate cultures, the debate surrounding office dress codes has gained widespread attention. While traditional perspectives advocate for strict business formal attire to preserve professionalism, I firmly believe that adopting a smart-casual dress code is vastly superior for employee satisfaction and creative performance.\\n\\nFirst and foremost, comfortable clothing directly promotes psychological well-being. When individuals are liberated from rigid suits and ties, they experience lower physical fatigue throughout long working hours, which consequently enhances cognitive efficiency and problem-solving agility. Numerous leading technology enterprises, such as Google and Apple, have long demonstrated that casual atmospheres stimulate groundbreaking innovation without undermining professional rigor.\\n\\nFurthermore, casual dress codes break down unnecessary hierarchical barriers among coworkers. In an open environment where junior staff and executives wear similar relaxed attire, team members feel more empowered to voice unconventional ideas during brainstorming sessions.\\n\\nIn conclusion, while formal dress remains appropriate for courtroom settings or diplomatic banquets, everyday office environments thrive most when prioritizing comfort and authentic collaboration.', ai_explain: 'Tiêu chí TOEIC Writing Essay: Cấu trúc 4 đoạn (Mở bài, 2 Thân bài, Kết luận), liên kết mạch lạc (Coherence), vốn từ học thuật phong phú.' } ] }, 'IELTS Listening · Section 1: Form Completion': { audioTitle: 'IELTS Listening Section 1 · Oceanic Hotel Conference Booking', audioScript: '[Receptionist]: Good morning, Oceanic Conference Suites. How can I help you today? [Customer]: Hello, I would like to book a conference room for our annual medical seminar next month. [Receptionist]: Certainly sir. May I take your full name? [Customer]: Yes, it is Dr. Arthur Pendelton. That is P-E-N-D-E-L-T-O-N. [Receptionist]: And the expected date of arrival? [Customer]: We plan to arrive on the fourteenth of November and depart on the seventeenth.', questions: [ { text: 'Question 1: What is the correct spelling of the client\'s family name?', translated: 'Họ của khách hàng được đánh vần chính xác như thế nào?', choices: ['PENDELTON', 'PEMBERTON', 'PENNINGTON', 'PENDLEBURY'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Đoạn băng đánh vần rõ ràng: P-E-N-D-E-L-T-O-N.' }, { text: 'Question 2: What is the purpose of the reservation?', translated: 'Mục đích của việc đặt phòng là gì?', choices: [ 'An annual medical research seminar', 'A family wedding anniversary celebration', 'A regional tennis championship banquet', 'An art exhibition gallery opening' ], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Khách hàng nói: "book a conference room for our annual medical seminar".' }, { text: 'Question 3: What is the scheduled arrival date?', translated: 'Ngày đến dự kiến là ngày nào?', choices: [ '14th of November', '17th of November', '4th of November', '21st of November' ], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Khách hàng nói: "arrive on the fourteenth of November" (14 tháng 11).' }, { text: 'Question 4: What special catering requirement did the doctor mention?', translated: 'Yêu cầu phục vụ đồ ăn đặc biệt nào được nhắc tới?', choices: [ 'Vegetarian and gluten-free dietary options', 'Traditional three-course French cuisine', 'Barbecue buffet served on the outdoor terrace', 'All meals must be served without seafood' ], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Trong hội thảo y khoa, khách hàng yêu cầu thực đơn ăn chay và không chứa gluten.' } ] }, 'IELTS Reading · Academic: Matching Headings': { passageTitle: 'The Architecture of Ancient Aqueducts', passageText: 'Paragraph A: The engineering prowess of the Roman Empire remains most visible through its monumental aqueduct systems. Spanning hundreds of kilometers across rugged topography, these gravity-fed waterways delivered thousands of cubic meters of fresh potable water to urban metropolises daily.\\n\\nParagraph B: The foundational principle of aqueduct design relied on a gentle, consistent downward gradient. If the decline was too steep, the rushing water would erode stone joints and rupture pipes; if too shallow, the current would stagnate and accumulate sediment.\\n\\nParagraph C: While stone archways are the iconic image of Roman water systems, arched bridges accounted for less than twenty percent of the total distance. The overwhelming majority of the conduit network was constructed underground, shielded from contamination, seasonal evaporation, and hostile military sabotage.', questions: [ { text: 'Which heading best fits Paragraph A?', translated: 'Tiêu đề nào phù hợp nhất với Đoạn A?', choices: [ 'A monumental feat of imperial civil engineering', 'The catastrophic decline of urban Roman populations', 'Chemical purification techniques in ancient cisterns', 'The financial collapse of public infrastructure' ], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Đoạn A ca ngợi tài năng kỹ thuật xây dựng công trình vĩ đại của đế chế La Mã (engineering prowess, monumental aqueduct systems).' }, { text: 'Which heading best fits Paragraph B?', translated: 'Tiêu đề nào phù hợp nhất với Đoạn B?', choices: [ 'The delicate balance of gravitational gradient calculations', 'The extraction of raw volcanic marble materials', 'Religious rituals dedicated to freshwater springs', 'Military defense strategies along border provinces' ], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Đoạn B giải thích việc tính toán độ dốc trọng lực (gravitational gradient) vừa đủ để nước chảy mà không làm vỡ ống hay đọng cặn.' }, { text: 'Which heading best fits Paragraph C?', translated: 'Tiêu đề nào phù hợp nhất với Đoạn C?', choices: [ 'The predominance and defensive utility of subterranean conduits', 'Architectural flaws of monumental stone archways', 'The seasonal fluctuation of Mediterranean rivers', 'The modern demolition of historic Roman bridges' ], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Đoạn C giải thích phần lớn đường ống nằm ngầm dưới lòng đất (subterranean conduits: hơn 80%) để bảo vệ nguồn nước khỏi bay hơi và quân địch.' }, { text: 'According to the passage, why were most aqueduct segments built below ground?', translated: 'Theo bài đọc, tại sao hầu hết các đoạn cống dẫn nước được xây dưới lòng đất?', choices: [ 'To guard against contamination, evaporation, and sabotage', 'Because stone quarries had exhausted their marble reserves', 'To avoid paying municipal urban property taxes', 'Because Roman law prohibited above-ground stone bridges' ], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Đoạn C chỉ rõ: "shielded from contamination, seasonal evaporation, and hostile military sabotage".' } ] }, 'IELTS Reading · True / False / Not Given': { passageTitle: 'Artificial Intelligence in Modern Healthcare', passageText: 'Recent breakthroughs in deep convolutional neural networks have accelerated the deployment of artificial intelligence across clinical diagnostics. In a landmark 2023 international clinical trial, an AI algorithm trained on more than 100,000 mammograms demonstrated a diagnostic accuracy matching senior board-certified radiologists in identifying early-stage malignant tumors. Crucially, the automated system reduced false positive diagnoses by approximately 5.7 percent, significantly decreasing unnecessary patient biopsies. However, medical ethicists emphasize that automated tools should assist, rather than replace, human practitioners.', questions: [ { text: 'Statement 1: The AI algorithm analyzed more than one hundred thousand diagnostic scans during its training.', translated: 'Khẳng định 1: Thuật toán AI đã phân tích hơn 100.000 bản chụp chẩn đoán trong giai đoạn huấn luyện.', choices: ['TRUE', 'FALSE', 'NOT GIVEN'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Bài đọc nêu rõ: "trained on more than 100,000 mammograms". Do đó là TRUE.' }, { text: 'Statement 2: The artificial intelligence system completely outperformed all human doctors in detecting all known illnesses.', translated: 'Khẳng định 2: Hệ thống AI vượt trội hoàn toàn tất cả các bác sĩ trong việc phát hiện mọi bệnh tật.', choices: ['TRUE', 'FALSE', 'NOT GIVEN'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Bài đọc chỉ nói AI đạt độ chính xác tương đương (matching) các bác sĩ X-quang kỳ cựu trong việc phát hiện khối u ác tính sớm, không hề vượt trội mọi bệnh. Do đó là FALSE.' }, { text: 'Statement 3: False positive diagnoses were reduced by more than fifteen percent.', translated: 'Khẳng định 3: Các chẩn đoán dương tính giả đã giảm hơn 15%.', choices: ['TRUE', 'FALSE', 'NOT GIVEN'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Bài đọc viết giảm khoảng 5.7%, không phải hơn 15%. Do đó là FALSE.' }, { text: 'Statement 4: The developers of the AI algorithm plan to launch a commercial smartphone application next year.', translated: 'Khẳng định 4: Nhóm phát triển thuật toán dự định ra mắt ứng dụng điện thoại thương mại vào năm sau.', choices: ['TRUE', 'FALSE', 'NOT GIVEN'], answer: 2, ai_explain: 'Bài đọc không hề đề cập đến ứng dụng điện thoại (smartphone app) hay kế hoạch năm sau. Do đó là NOT GIVEN.' } ] }, 'IELTS Writing · Task 2: Opinion Essay': { type: 'writing', questions: [ { text: 'Writing Task 2: Essay Prompt\\nDirections: Some people argue that technological advancements in automation and artificial intelligence will inevitably lead to widespread unemployment, while others believe that technology creates more meaningful job opportunities than it destroys.\\n\\nDiscuss both views and give your own reasoned opinion. Write at least 250 words.', translated: 'IELTS Writing Task 2: Tranh luận về tác động của AI/Tự động hóa đến việc làm. Thảo luận cả 2 quan điểm và nêu ý kiến bản thân (tối thiểu 250 từ).', minWords: 250, sampleAnswer: 'The exponential acceleration of artificial intelligence and robotic automation has ignited profound socioeconomic debates regarding the future of human labor. While a substantial demographic fears that mechanized efficiency will trigger systemic technological unemployment, I contend that innovation historically displaces routine manual labor while spawning far richer, intellectually stimulating vocations.\\n\\nOn the one hand, apprehension regarding job obsolescence is undeniably justified in the short term. Repetitive cognitive and physical tasks, such as factory assembly, basic bookkeeping, and customer service telephone routing, can now be executed by algorithms with unprecedented speed and zero fatigue. Consequently, vulnerable workforces lacking access to technical retraining face genuine risks of economic marginalization. For example, the automation of automated toll booths and self-checkout kiosks has visibly reduced entry-level clerical employment worldwide.\\n\\nOn the other hand, technological revolutions have historically catalyzed net employment expansion rather than permanent deprivation. When routine tasks are automated, overall productivity surges and operational overhead declines, releasing capital for investment into novel industries. Emerging domains such as renewable energy grid management, bioinformatic engineering, cybernetic defense, and creative content architecture did not exist three decades ago. Furthermore, machines fundamentally lack empathy, nuanced ethical discernment, and complex artistic intuition—qualities that will remain distinctly human advantages in education, psychological counseling, and strategic leadership.\\n\\nIn conclusion, while the transition period necessitates proactive governmental investment into adult digital literacy and vocational reskilling, artificial intelligence should be recognized not as an economic destroyer, but as a transformative tool that elevates human potential.', ai_explain: 'Tiêu chí chấm IELTS Writing Task 2 (Band 1.0 - 9.0):\\n1. Task Achievement (Giải quyết trọn vẹn cả 2 quan điểm)\\n2. Coherence and Cohesion (Liên kết mạch lạc giữa các đoạn)\\n3. Lexical Resource (Từ vựng học thuật C1/C2 phong phú)\\n4. Grammatical Range and Accuracy (Đa dạng cấu trúc câu phức/ghép, không lỗi ngữ pháp).' } ] }, 'IELTS Speaking · Part 2 & 3: Cue Card': { type: 'speaking', questions: [ { text: 'IELTS Speaking Part 2: Cue Card\\nDescribe an environmental problem that your country or community is facing.\\nYou should say:\\n- What the problem is and how severe it is\\n- What causes this problem\\n- How it impacts people\'s everyday lives\\nAnd explain what measures can be taken to solve or mitigate it.', translated: 'IELTS Speaking Part 2: Thuyết trình 2 phút miêu tả một vấn đề môi trường mà cộng đồng của bạn đang đối mặt, nguyên nhân, ảnh hưởng và giải pháp.', prepTime: 60, speakTime: 120, sampleAnswer: 'I would like to talk about the escalating issue of urban air pollution and particulate smog in major metropolitan areas in Vietnam. Over the past decade, rapid industrialization paired with an overwhelming density of private gasoline motorbikes has significantly degraded ambient air quality.\\n\\nThe primary drivers behind this crisis are twofold: emissions from heavy vehicular traffic during morning rush hours, and unregulated construction dust from rapid urban development. On days when hazardous PM2.5 levels spike, residents experience respiratory ailments, eye irritation, and long-term cardiovascular risks.\\n\\nTo combat this pressing crisis, municipalities must expand clean public transit networks, incentivize electric two-wheelers, and enforce strict dust-suppression regulations on commercial builders. Public awareness campaigns also play a crucial role in encouraging greener lifestyle habits.', ai_explain: 'Tiêu chí chấm IELTS Speaking: Fluency & Coherence (Độ lưu loát và mạch lạc), Lexical Resource (Vốn từ theo chủ đề môi trường), Grammatical Range (Cấu trúc ngữ pháp), Pronunciation (Phát âm và ngữ điệu tự nhiên).' }, { text: 'IELTS Speaking Part 3: Two-way Discussion\\nDiscussion Question: Do you believe international treaties or individual consumer actions are more effective in curbing global carbon emissions?', translated: 'IELTS Speaking Part 3: Bạn nghĩ hiệp ước quốc tế hay hành động của từng người tiêu dùng hiệu quả hơn trong việc cắt giảm khí thải toàn cầu?', prepTime: 15, speakTime: 60, sampleAnswer: 'In my perspective, while individual lifestyle modifications like reducing single-use plastics are commendable, legally binding international treaties wield vastly superior influence. Global agreements compel national governments to legislate carbon tax frameworks, mandate industrial emission ceilings, and redirect billions of subsidies toward green renewable infrastructure. Without macro-level institutional mandates, grassroots consumer efforts simply cannot operate at the scale required to mitigate global climate change.', ai_explain: 'Cần phân tích đa chiều (Macro vs Micro), dùng từ vựng học thuật (legally binding, institutional mandates, grassroots efforts).' } ] } }; // ========================================== // 2. SCORING ENGINES: TOEIC (10-990) & IELTS (1.0-9.0) // ========================================== function calculateToeicScore(correct, total, skill) { const ratio = total > 0 ? (correct / total) : 0; let scaledScore = 0; if (skill === 'Listening') { scaledScore = Math.round(5 + ratio * 490); scaledScore = Math.min(495, Math.max(5, Math.round(scaledScore / 5) * 5)); } else if (skill === 'Reading') { scaledScore = Math.round(5 + ratio * 490); scaledScore = Math.min(495, Math.max(5, Math.round(scaledScore / 5) * 5)); } else { // Speaking & Writing (thang 200) scaledScore = Math.round(ratio * 200); scaledScore = Math.min(200, Math.max(10, Math.round(scaledScore / 10) * 10)); } let cefr = 'A1'; if (scaledScore >= 400 || (skill !== 'Listening' && skill !== 'Reading' && scaledScore >= 160)) cefr = 'C1 (Advanced)'; else if (scaledScore >= 300 || scaledScore >= 120) cefr = 'B2 (Upper-Intermediate)'; else if (scaledScore >= 200 || scaledScore >= 80) cefr = 'B1 (Intermediate)'; else cefr = 'A2 (Elementary)'; return { scaledScore: scaledScore, maxScore: (skill === 'Listening' || skill === 'Reading') ? 495 : 200, cefr: cefr, display: `${scaledScore} pts (${cefr})` }; } function calculateIeltsBand(correct, total, skill) { const ratio = total > 0 ? (correct / total) : 0; let band = 1.0; if (ratio >= 0.90) band = 8.5; else if (ratio >= 0.80) band = 7.5; else if (ratio >= 0.70) band = 7.0; else if (ratio >= 0.60) band = 6.5; else if (ratio >= 0.50) band = 6.0; else if (ratio >= 0.40) band = 5.5; else if (ratio >= 0.30) band = 5.0; else band = 4.0; let badge = 'Competent User'; if (band >= 8.0) badge = 'Very Good / Expert User'; else if (band >= 7.0) badge = 'Good User'; else if (band >= 6.0) badge = 'Competent User'; else badge = 'Modest User'; return { band: band.toFixed(1), badge: badge, display: `Band ${band.toFixed(1)} · ${badge}` }; } // ========================================== // 3. BOOKMARK & REPORT SYSTEM // ========================================== function getBookmarks() { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lingua-bookmarks') || '[]'); } function getReports() { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lingua-reports') || '[]'); } function isQuestionBookmarked(title, qIndex) { const list = getBookmarks(); return list.some(b => b.title === title && b.qIndex === qIndex); } function toggleBookmark(title, qIndex) { let list = getBookmarks(); const existingIdx = list.findIndex(b => b.title === title && b.qIndex === qIndex); if (existingIdx !== -1) { list.splice(existingIdx, 1); localStorage.setItem('lingua-bookmarks', JSON.stringify(list)); notify('Đã xóa câu hỏi khỏi sổ tay lưu trữ.'); } else { const exam = examDatabase[title] || { questions: questions }; const q = exam.questions[qIndex]; list.unshift({ id: 'bm_' + Date.now(), title: title, qIndex: qIndex, date: new Date().toISOString(), questionText: q.text, translated: q.translated, choices: q.choices, answer: q.answer, ai_explain: q.ai_explain }); localStorage.setItem('lingua-bookmarks', JSON.stringify(list)); notify('⭐ Đã lưu câu hỏi vào Sổ tay!'); } renderQuestion(); renderBookmarksView(); } let activeReportingContext = null; function openReportModal(title, qIndex) { activeReportingContext = { title, qIndex }; $('#report-q-index').value = qIndex; $('#report-modal').classList.add('open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; } function closeReportModal() { $('#report-modal').classList.remove('open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; activeReportingContext = null; } function submitReport(e) { e.preventDefault(); if (!activeReportingContext) return; const selectedReason = $('input[name="report_reason"]:checked')?.value || 'Khác'; const note = $('#report-note').value.trim(); const { title, qIndex } = activeReportingContext; const exam = examDatabase[title] || { questions: questions }; const q = exam.questions[qIndex] || {}; const reports = getReports(); reports.unshift({ id: 'rep_' + Date.now(), title: title, qIndex: qIndex, date: new Date().toISOString(), reason: selectedReason, note: note, questionText: q.text || 'Câu hỏi', status: 'Đã tiếp nhận' }); localStorage.setItem('lingua-reports', JSON.stringify(reports)); closeReportModal(); notify('🚩 Cảm ơn bạn! Báo cáo đã được ghi nhận.'); renderBookmarksView(); renderQuestion(); } function switchBookmarkTab(tab) { if (tab === 'bookmarks') { $('#tab-btn-bookmarks').classList.add('active'); $('#tab-btn-reports').classList.remove('active'); $('#tab-content-bookmarks').style.display = 'block'; $('#tab-content-reports').style.display = 'none'; } else { $('#tab-btn-bookmarks').classList.remove('active'); $('#tab-btn-reports').classList.add('active'); $('#tab-content-bookmarks').style.display = 'none'; $('#tab-content-reports').style.display = 'block'; } } function renderBookmarksView() { const bookmarks = getBookmarks(); const reports = getReports(); if ($('#count-bookmarks')) $('#count-bookmarks').textContent = bookmarks.length; if ($('#count-reports')) $('#count-reports').textContent = reports.length; // Render Bookmarks const bList = $('#bookmarks-list'); if (bList) { if (bookmarks.length === 0) { bList.innerHTML = `
    ⭐

    Chưa có câu hỏi nào được lưu

    Trong lúc làm bài thi, bấm "Lưu câu" để xem lại những câu hỏi cần nhớ nhé.

    `; } else { bList.innerHTML = bookmarks.map((b, i) => `
    ${b.title} Câu ${b.qIndex + 1}

    ${b.questionText}

    ${b.translated || ''}

    Đáp án đúng: ${b.choices ? b.choices[b.answer] : 'N/A'}
    ${b.ai_explain || ''}
    `).join(''); } } // Render Reports const rList = $('#reports-list'); if (rList) { if (reports.length === 0) { rList.innerHTML = `
    🚩

    Chưa có báo cáo nào

    Nếu phát hiện lỗi ngữ pháp hay đáp án chưa chuẩn, bạn hãy báo cáo để Lingua hoàn thiện hơn.

    `; } else { rList.innerHTML = reports.map((r, i) => `
    🚩 ${r.reason} ${r.status}

    ${r.title} · Câu ${r.qIndex + 1} · ${new Date(r.date).toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')}

    "${r.questionText.slice(0, 100)}..."

    ${r.note ? `

    Ghi chú của bạn: ${r.note}

    ` : ''}
    `).join(''); } } } function removeBookmark(title, qIndex) { toggleBookmark(title, qIndex); } // ========================================== // 4. USER PROFILE & TARGETS // ========================================== function getUserProfile() { const stored = localStorage.getItem('lingua-profile'); if (stored) return JSON.parse(stored); const username = localStorage.getItem('lingua-user') || 'Minh Anh'; return { name: username, email: username.includes('@') ? username : `${username.toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, '')}@lingua.edu.vn`, targetExam: 'TOEIC 750+', targetDate: new Date(Date.now() + 45 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0] }; } function saveUserProfile(profile) { localStorage.setItem('lingua-profile', JSON.stringify(profile)); localStorage.setItem('lingua-user', profile.name); showApp(profile.name); renderProfileView(); notify('Cập nhật hồ sơ & mục tiêu thành công!'); } function renderProfileView() { const profile = getUserProfile(); if ($('#profile-display-name')) $('#profile-display-name').textContent = profile.name; if ($('#profile-email')) $('#profile-email').textContent = profile.email; if ($('#profile-target-title')) $('#profile-target-title').textContent = profile.targetExam; const initials = profile.name.trim().split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() || 'MA'; if ($('#profile-big-avatar')) $('#profile-big-avatar').textContent = initials; // Countdown if (profile.targetDate && $('#profile-countdown')) { const diff = Math.ceil((new Date(profile.targetDate) - new Date()) / (1000 * 3600 * 24)); $('#profile-countdown').textContent = diff > 0 ? `Còn ${diff} ngày tới ngày thi` : 'Đã đến ngày thi!'; } // Fill form fields if ($('#edit-profile-name')) $('#edit-profile-name').value = profile.name; if ($('#edit-profile-exam')) $('#edit-profile-exam').value = profile.targetExam; if ($('#edit-profile-date')) $('#edit-profile-date').value = profile.targetDate || ''; // Calculate skill stats from real history const history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lingua-history') || '[]'); const stats = { Listening: { correct: 0, total: 0 }, Reading: { correct: 0, total: 0 }, Writing: { correct: 0, total: 0 }, Speaking: { correct: 0, total: 0 } }; history.forEach(item => { const skill = item.skill || (item.title.includes('Listening') ? [Photo 3] Narrator: Look at the photograph marked Number 3. (A) Boxes are being loaded onto a delivery truck. (B) A worker is sealing packages with tape. (A) A woman is handing a folder to her colleague. (B) Two colleagues are seated across from each other, looking at a laptop. (C) A woman is typing on a keyboard in the office. PART 2 – QUESTION-RESPONSE (7 questions) Narrator: Mark your answer on your answer sheet. 7. Man: When is the quarterly sales report due? (A) Yes, it was due last month. (B) By the end of Thursday. (C) At the marketing conference room. 8. Woman: Could you review my presentation slides before the meeting? (A) I already submitted the slides online. (B) Sure, send them over this afternoon. (C) The meeting was held on Friday. 9. Man: Has the new office furniture been delivered yet? (A) It arrived this morning and is in the storage room. (B) The furniture store is two blocks away. (C) We ordered three new chairs. 10. Woman: Who will be leading the training session tomorrow? (A) The training was excellent. (B) It will be conducted by Ms. Park from HR. (C) The session runs for two hours. 11. Man: Do you know where the parking validation forms are? (A) The parking lot is on level B2. (B) I think Lisa keeps them at the reception desk. (C) Validation takes about fifteen minutes. 12. Woman: Should we reschedule the client call or keep it at ten? (A) The client is from Toronto. (B) Let's push it back to eleven — Mr. Chen has a conflict. (C) The call went very well, thank you. 13. Man: Isn't the annual budget review meeting next Monday? (A) Actually, it was moved to Wednesday afternoon. (B) Yes, the budget was approved last week. (C) Finance handles all the reviews. PART 3 – SHORT CONVERSATIONS (3 conversations × 3 questions) Narrator: You will hear conversations between two or three people. Answer three questions about each. CONVERSATION 1 (Q14–16): Receptionist: Good morning, Pinnacle Consulting Group. How may I direct your call? Caller (Mr. Tanaka): Hello, this is Hiroshi Tanaka calling from Kyoto Manufacturing. I have a ten o'clock appointment with Ms. Rachel Torres. Receptionist: Certainly, Mr. Tanaka. I'm afraid Ms. Torres is currently in an internal meeting that's running a bit late. She asked me to apologise and let you know she'll be available in approximately twenty minutes. Caller: I see. Is there a conference room where I can wait and review some documents? Receptionist: Absolutely. Please take the elevator to the fourteenth floor, and our assistant Sandra will direct you to Conference Room C. We'll also have coffee and water available for you. Caller: That's very kind. One more thing — could you ask Ms. Torres to have the draft contract ready when she comes in? I'd like to go over the payment terms. Receptionist: Of course. I'll pass that message along immediately. CONVERSATION 2 (Q17–19): Team Leader (Karen): Okay team, quick update before we go live with the summer campaign. The graphic design team has finished all fifteen banner ads, but we're still waiting on the approved copy for the social media posts. Marketing Executive (David): I spoke with copywriting this morning. They said the copy will be ready by end of day today — they're just waiting for the legal sign-off on the promotional discount language. Karen: Good. And the email newsletter — has that been proofread? David: Yes, I proofread it yesterday and sent it back with three minor corrections. It should be finalised this afternoon. Karen: Perfect. What about the influencer partnership posts? Marketing Executive 2 (Priya): Those are on schedule. The influencers post on Thursday morning at nine, Eastern time, which should hit peak engagement for our target audience. Karen: Excellent. Let's do a final review call tomorrow at eleven to confirm everything's in order before we set the campaign live Friday morning. CONVERSATION 3 (Q20–22): Employee A (Tom): Sarah, have you heard about the office relocation? Sarah: Yes! I heard we're moving to the new building in Midtown next quarter. Tom: That's right. I went to the planning committee briefing yesterday. The new space has open-plan seating for the main teams, but each department head will have a private office on the perimeter. Sarah: What about meeting rooms? Our team is always fighting over the conference rooms here. Tom: They've designed twelve dedicated meeting rooms, plus four collaboration pods for smaller groups. And apparently there'll be a rooftop terrace for casual meetings and break times. Sarah: That sounds significantly better. What about the gym subsidy — will that continue at the new location? Tom: I actually asked about that. The new building has an on-site gym in the basement, so the company will provide free employee access instead of the existing monthly subsidy. PART 4 – TALKS (2 talks × 3 questions) Narrator: You will hear two short talks given by a single speaker. TALK 1 (Q23–25) – WORKPLACE ANNOUNCEMENT: Narrator: Questions 23 through 25 refer to the following announcement. Attention all Meridian Financial employees. This is a reminder that starting from next Monday, the company will be implementing a hybrid work policy for all departments. Under the new policy, employees will be required to work from the office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, while Mondays and Fridays will be designated as remote working days. This arrangement has been approved following a three-month pilot programme in which overall team productivity increased by eighteen percent while employee satisfaction scores rose significantly. Please note that attendance tracking will begin on the first Monday of next month, so there's a two-week transition period during which you should begin familiarising yourself with the new scheduling system accessible via the HR portal. Department managers will hold individual briefings with their teams this week to address any specific questions. (A) installs (B) is installed (C) will be installing (D) installed PART 6 – TEXT COMPLETION (Q11–Q14) Questions 11-14 refer to the following internal memo: TO: All Customer Service Representatives FROM: Department Head, Jennifer Walsh DATE: October 14, 2024 SUBJECT: Updated Protocol for Client Escalations Effective immediately, all customer escalations that cannot be resolved within fifteen minutes must be ------- (11) to a senior representative. This policy has been established in response to our recent client satisfaction survey, which indicated that response times and resolution quality ------- (12) the primary factors driving client dissatisfaction. Going forward, all escalation cases must be documented in the CRM system with a detailed summary of the issue, the actions taken, and the resolution outcome. This documentation is ------- (13) for tracking patterns in client complaints and identifying areas for service improvement. A dedicated escalation queue ------- (14) in the system next Monday, and all representatives will receive training on the updated interface during this week's Friday afternoon session. Thank you for your continued commitment to providing exceptional service. Q11: (A) referred (B) refer (C) referring (D) to refer Q12: (A) was (B) are (C) were (D) has been Q13: (A) essential (B) essentially (C) essentiality (D) essence Q14: (A) launched (B) will be launched (C) launching (D) is launch PART 7 – READING COMPREHENSION SINGLE PASSAGE (Q15–18): E-MAIL From: Marcus Bellamy To: Accounting Team Date: September 30, 2024 Subject: Reminder: Q3 Financial Statements Dear Team, This is a friendly reminder that the Q3 financial statements are due by Friday, October 4. Please ensure all departmental budget reconciliations are submitted to Priya Kapoor by Wednesday, October 2 at 5:00 PM at the latest, as she requires time to compile the consolidated report. If you anticipate difficulty meeting this deadline, please contact me directly no later than Tuesday morning so we can discuss an extension or alternative arrangement. Extensions will only be granted under exceptional circumstances and must be approved by the CFO. All files should be submitted in the approved Excel template, version 3.2, which is available on the shared drive under Accounting > Templates > 2024. Please do not use older template versions as they are not compatible with our updated financial reporting software. Best regards, Marcus Bellamy Director of Finance, Ridge Corporation Q15: What is the primary purpose of the email? (A) To introduce a new accounting software platform (B) To remind staff of an upcoming deadline for financial statements (C) To announce changes to the company's fiscal year calendar (D) To request approval for an accounting team expansion Q16: By when should departmental reconciliations be submitted to Priya Kapoor? (A) By Monday, September 30 (B) By Tuesday, October 1 at noon (C) By Wednesday, October 2 at 5:00 PM (D) By Friday, October 4 at close of business Q17: Under what circumstances will deadline extensions be granted? (A) When an employee has approved annual leave during the deadline period (B) Under exceptional circumstances with CFO approval (C) For any request submitted before Thursday morning (D) When the departmental head requests an extension on behalf of the team Q18: Where can staff find the correct Excel template? (A) On the HR intranet portal under Forms & Documents (B) In an attachment to a previous team email (C) On the shared drive under Accounting > Templates > 2024 (D) By requesting it directly from Priya Kapoor DOUBLE PASSAGE (Q19–24): PASSAGE A – NOTICE: Ridgewood Business Centre ATTN: All Tenants RE: Scheduled Maintenance – Main Elevator System DATE: October 10, 2024 Please be advised that the main elevator bank (Elevators 1–3) in Building A will be out of service from Monday, October 21 to Friday, October 25 for scheduled preventive maintenance and safety certification renewal. During this period, Elevator 4 (freight elevator, located in the service corridor on the eastern side of the building) will be made available to all tenants for regular passenger use. Due to its smaller capacity, we ask tenants to limit elevator use to essential trips and to use the stairwells (Floors 1–5) where physically able. The building management team apologises for any inconvenience and appreciates your patience during this necessary maintenance period. Any tenant with specific accessibility needs should contact building management at ext. 2200 before October 18 to arrange alternative accommodation. PASSAGE B – EMAIL: From: Claire Hutchinson To: Building Management Date: October 16, 2024 Subject: Re: Elevator Maintenance Notice Dear Building Management, Thank you for the advance notice regarding the upcoming elevator maintenance. I am writing on behalf of Veritas Law Associates, who occupy the twelfth floor. We have two team members with mobility limitations who rely on elevator access daily. I contacted your office this morning and spoke with a representative who suggested that we coordinate with the freight elevator operator. However, I wanted to confirm in writing that these two employees will have priority access to Elevator 4 during the maintenance period, particularly during the morning (9:00–9:30 AM) and evening (5:30–6:00 PM) peak periods. Could you also advise whether there are temporary handrails being installed in the stairwells? While our mobility-limited staff cannot use the stairs, our other team members would appreciate the added safety measure. Thank you for your assistance. Best regards, Claire Hutchinson Office Manager, Veritas Law Associates Q19: How long will the main elevator bank be out of service? (A) Three business days (B) Five business days (C) Seven business days (D) Two weeks Q20: Which elevator will be available to all tenants during maintenance? (A) Elevator 1 on the main lobby level (B) The freight elevator (Elevator 4) on the eastern side (C) A temporary elevator being installed for the period (D) Elevators 2 and 3 on an alternating schedule Q21: What does the notice ask tenants with accessibility needs to do? (A) Submit a written request to the city council (B) Contact building management before October 18 (C) Arrange alternative accommodation independently (D) Email the maintenance contractor directly Q22: Who is Claire Hutchinson and why is she writing? (A) She is a building inspector writing to confirm compliance certificates (B) She is an office manager writing to request priority elevator access for mobility-limited employees (C) She is a tenant committee representative proposing schedule changes (D) She is a building management representative acknowledging the notice Q23: What does Claire Hutchinson ask about in addition to elevator access? (A) Whether parking spaces will be affected during maintenance (B) Whether temporary handrails will be installed in the stairwells (C) Whether compensation will be provided for business disruption (D) Whether the maintenance period can be shortened Q24: Which floor does Veritas Law Associates occupy? (A) Fifth floor (B) Eighth floor (C) Tenth floor (D) Twelfth floor`, questions: [ // PART 5 (Q1-10) { text: 'Q1 (Part 5): The marketing department ------- a comprehensive social media strategy for the upcoming launch.', translated: 'Phòng marketing _______ một chiến lược truyền thông xã hội toàn diện cho lần ra mắt sắp tới.', choices: ['develop', 'will be developing', 'developed', 'is developed'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Dùng "will be developing" vì đây là hành động đang diễn ra trong tương lai (future continuous). "developed" là quá khứ đơn không phù hợp.' }, { text: 'Q2 (Part 5): All employees must submit expense reports ------- the end of the fiscal quarter.', translated: 'Tất cả nhân viên phải nộp báo cáo chi phí _______ cuối quý tài chính.', choices: ['by', 'at', 'for', 'since'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"By" + điểm thời gian = deadline (hạn chót). "Submit by the end of" = "nộp trước cuối." "At" dùng cho thời gian chính xác (at 5 PM), không phải khoảng thời gian.' }, { text: 'Q3 (Part 5): The conference room ------- for the executive meeting, so the team had to find an alternative location.', translated: 'Phòng họp _______ cho cuộc họp ban điều hành, vì vậy nhóm phải tìm địa điểm thay thế.', choices: ['is reserving', 'has been reserved', 'reserved', 'will reserve'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"has been reserved" — Present Perfect Passive. Phòng được đặt trước (bởi ai đó, không rõ) → đây là passive voice hiện tại hoàn thành, thể hiện trạng thái hiện tại (phòng đã được đặt rồi).' }, { text: 'Q4 (Part 5): Ms. Chen, ------- handles all international client accounts, will attend the Frankfurt trade fair.', translated: 'Bà Chen, _______ xử lý tất cả tài khoản khách hàng quốc tế, sẽ tham dự hội chợ thương mại Frankfurt.', choices: ['who', 'which', 'whom', 'whose'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"who" — Relative pronoun thay thế cho người (Ms. Chen) và là chủ ngữ của mệnh đề quan hệ (handles). "Whom" là tân ngữ, "whose" là sở hữu.' }, { text: 'Q5 (Part 5): The renovated factory ------- produce twice the number of units compared to last year.', translated: 'Nhà máy được cải tạo _______ sản xuất gấp đôi số lượng đơn vị so với năm ngoái.', choices: ['able to', 'is able to', 'has able', 'was able'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"is able to" — cụm "be able to" cần trợ động từ "be" đúng ngữ pháp. "Able to" đứng một mình là sai. "Was able" thiếu "to" ở sau.' }, { text: 'Q6 (Part 5): Staff should notify supervisors ------- they plan to take extended leave during peak season.', translated: 'Nhân viên nên thông báo cho giám sát viên _______ họ dự định nghỉ phép kéo dài trong mùa cao điểm.', choices: ['so that', 'despite', 'although', 'whenever'], answer: 3, ai_explain: '"whenever" = bất cứ khi nào. Đây là điều kiện/thời gian: "whenever they plan..." Loại "so that" (mục đích), "despite" (tương phản, cần gerund), "although" (tương phản, logic sai).' }, { text: 'Q7 (Part 5): The board of directors ------- unanimously to approve the merger proposal.', translated: 'Hội đồng quản trị _______ nhất trí để phê duyệt đề xuất sáp nhập.', choices: ['voted', 'votes', 'is voting', 'vote'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"voted" — quá khứ đơn. "After three months of negotiations" = đây là sự kiện đã xảy ra trong quá khứ. "Board of directors" là chủ thể tập thể, dùng số ít hoặc số nhiều tùy ngữ cảnh, nhưng ở đây "voted" (plural agreement) phù hợp.' }, { text: 'Q8 (Part 5): The report contained several ------- errors that had to be corrected.', translated: 'Báo cáo chứa một số lỗi _______ phải được sửa chữa.', choices: ['significance', 'significantly', 'significant', 'signify'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"significant" — tính từ (adjective) bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "errors." "Significance" là danh từ, "significantly" là trạng từ, "signify" là động từ.' }, { text: 'Q9 (Part 5): Neither the CEO nor the board members ------- available to comment on the acquisition.', translated: 'Cả CEO lẫn các thành viên hội đồng đều không _______ sẵn sàng bình luận về việc mua lại.', choices: ['was', 'were', 'is', 'has been'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Neither... nor" với chủ ngữ số nhiều ("board members") đứng gần verb → verb chia số nhiều: "were." Quy tắc "proximity" (gần nhất) trong Neither...nor / Either...or.' }, { text: 'Q10 (Part 5): The software update ------- automatically each night at midnight.', translated: 'Bản cập nhật phần mềm _______ tự động mỗi đêm lúc nửa đêm.', choices: ['installs', 'is installed', 'will be installing', 'installed'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"is installed" — Passive Present Simple. Phần mềm "được cài đặt" (by the system/automatically) → passive voice. "Installs" là active, không phù hợp vì software không tự cài mà "được cài."' }, // PART 6 (Q11-14) { text: 'Q11 (Part 6): Escalations that cannot be resolved within fifteen minutes must be ------- to a senior representative.', translated: 'Các trường hợp leo thang không thể giải quyết trong 15 phút phải được _______ cho đại diện cấp cao.', choices: ['referred', 'refer', 'referring', 'to refer'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"referred" — Passive voice: "must be referred" (cần được chuyển tiếp). "Must be + past participle" là cấu trúc modal passive chuẩn.' }, { text: 'Q12 (Part 6): The survey indicated that response times and resolution quality ------- the primary factors driving client dissatisfaction.', translated: 'Khảo sát cho thấy thời gian phản hồi và chất lượng giải quyết _______ các yếu tố chính gây ra sự không hài lòng của khách hàng.', choices: ['was', 'are', 'were', 'has been'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"were" — Past Simple vì đây là kết quả từ khảo sát đã được thực hiện ("survey indicated" → past). Chủ ngữ "response times and resolution quality" là số nhiều → "were."' }, { text: 'Q13 (Part 6): This documentation is ------- for tracking patterns in client complaints.', translated: 'Tài liệu này là _______ để theo dõi các mẫu trong khiếu nại của khách hàng.', choices: ['essential', 'essentially', 'essentiality', 'essence'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"essential" — tính từ sau "is" (predicate adjective). "is essential" = "là điều thiết yếu." "Essentially" là trạng từ, không dùng sau "is" để mô tả noun.' }, { text: 'Q14 (Part 6): A dedicated escalation queue ------- in the system next Monday.', translated: 'Một hàng chờ xử lý leo thang chuyên dụng _______ trong hệ thống vào thứ Hai tới.', choices: ['launched', 'will be launched', 'launching', 'is launch'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"will be launched" — Future Passive. Test 1 – Full Speaking (11 Câu)': { type: 'speaking', questions: [ // Questions 1-2: Read a text aloud { text: 'Q1 (Read Aloud – 45 giây đọc): Read the following text aloud. "Thank you for calling Hartfield International Airport Information Services. Our terminal operates twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week. For flight arrivals and departures, please press one. For parking and ground transportation, please press two. To speak with a customer service representative, please remain on the line, and your call will be answered in the order it was received. We appreciate your patience."', translated: 'Q1: Đọc to đoạn thông báo dịch vụ thông tin sân bay.', choices: ['🎯 Tiêu chí chấm (Pronunciation & Intonation): Nhịp điệu tự nhiên, phát âm rõ ràng các từ kỹ thuật (terminal, transportation, representative). Chú ý: nhấn mạnh số (one, two) và dừng sau mỗi hướng dẫn. Không đọc quá nhanh — tốc độ 130-150 từ/phút là lý tưởng.', '📋 Từ phát âm cần lưu ý: terminal /ˈtɜːmɪnəl/ — international /ˌɪntəˈnæʃənəl/ — representative /ˌrɛprɪˈzɛntətɪv/ — transportation /ˌtrænspɔːˈteɪʃən/'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Read Aloud: Điểm cao khi phát âm chính xác, nhịp điệu tự nhiên, intonation phù hợp (giọng hướng dẫn xuống cuối câu), không ngập ngừng.' }, { text: 'Q2 (Read Aloud – 45 giây đọc): Read the following announcement aloud. "Attention all conference participants. The keynote address by Dr. Maria Santos will begin promptly at two PM in the Grand Ballroom on the third floor. Seating is limited, so we encourage early arrival. Light refreshments will be available in the foyer outside the ballroom from one-thirty PM. Please ensure your conference badge is visible at all times. Thank you."', translated: 'Q2: Đọc to thông báo hội nghị.', choices: ['🎯 Tiêu chí chấm: Intonation đúng với giọng thông báo chính thức (formal announcement). Nhấn mạnh thông tin quan trọng: "two PM", "Grand Ballroom", "third floor", "limited seating." Ngừng đúng sau mỗi câu.', '📋 Từ phát âm khó: keynote /ˈkiːnəʊt/ — promptly /ˈprɒmptli/ — refreshments /rɪˈfrɛʃmənts/ — foyer /ˈfɔɪeɪ/ — ballroom /ˈbɔːlruːm/'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Formal announcement intonation: nhấn rõ thông tin địa điểm và thời gian. Bắt buộc đọc rõ số (two PM, third floor, one-thirty PM).' }, // Question 3: Describe a photograph { text: 'Q3 (Mô tả ảnh – 30 giây chuẩn bị, 45 giây nói): Describe what you see in the photograph. [Photograph: A busy open-plan office. Several employees are working at their computers. In the foreground, a woman in a blue blazer is speaking on the phone while looking at documents. In the background, two men are standing near a whiteboard discussing something. Natural light comes through large windows on the left side.]', translated: 'Q3: Mô tả bức ảnh văn phòng cởi mở bận rộn.', choices: ['✍️ BÀI MẪU BAND 8/9 (45 giây): "In this photograph, I can see a busy open-plan office environment. In the foreground, a professional woman dressed in a blue blazer appears to be multitasking — she is speaking on the phone while simultaneously reviewing documents on her desk. The expression on her face suggests focused concentration. Moving to the background, two male colleagues are engaged in what appears to be a collaborative discussion beside a whiteboard, which has various diagrams or notes on it. The office benefits from considerable natural light streaming in through large windows visible on the left side of the image, creating a bright and professional working atmosphere. Overall, this image conveys the dynamic, fast-paced nature of a modern corporate workplace."', '🎯 Structure cho Photo Description: 1. General scene overview (1 câu) → 2. Foreground details (2-3 câu) → 3. Background details (2 câu) → 4. Overall impression (1 câu). Total: ~7-8 câu trong 45 giây.'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Photo description: Mô tả từ tổng quan → chi tiết foreground → chi tiết background. Dùng "In the foreground...", "Moving to the background...", "appears to be doing..." cho sự tự nhiên.' }, // Questions 4-6: Respond to questions { text: 'Q4 (Trả lời câu hỏi – 15 giây): Imagine you are talking to a market researcher about shopping habits. [Researcher]: How often do you go shopping for clothing?', translated: 'Q4: Bạn mua quần áo bao lâu một lần?', choices: ['✍️ BÀI MẪU 15 GIÂY: "Honestly, I\'d say about once a month. Brand name matters much less than those two factors."', '🎯 Tip: Liệt kê 2 yếu tố + giải thích ngắn. Tránh trả lời chỉ "Quality and price." Thêm 1 lý do = đủ điểm cao.'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Q5: Factor questions = liệt kê ưu tiên + giải thích ngắn lý do tại sao. Tại sao?', choices: ['✍️ BÀI MẪU 15 GIÂY: "Primarily online, to be honest. The convenience of comparing prices across multiple platforms and reading customer reviews before buying has made it my default choice. That said, I still prefer to try on shoes or structured clothing in store before committing to a purchase."', '🎯 Tip: State preference + main reason + exception/nuance. Ba yếu tố này tạo câu trả lời 15 giây hoàn chỉnh và thuyết phục.'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Q6: Online vs in-store = state clear preference + reason + nuance (exception). Đừng nói "both are fine" — thiếu rõ ràng.' }, // Questions 7-9: Respond to questions using information provided { text: 'Q7 (Trả lời có tài liệu – 30 giây): The following schedule has been provided. [SCHEDULE: Greenhill Community Workshop Series — Saturday, November 9. 9:00 AM – Welcome & Registration (Main Hall). 10:00 AM – Photography Basics (Room 101). 11:00 AM – Social Media Marketing (Room 203). 12:30 PM – Networking Lunch (Cafeteria). 2:00 PM – Creative Writing Workshop (Library). 3:30 PM – Panel Discussion: Careers in Creative Industries (Main Hall). 5:00 PM – Event Close.] [Question]: What time does the photography session begin, and where is it held?', translated: 'Q7: Buổi học nhiếp ảnh bắt đầu lúc mấy giờ và được tổ chức ở đâu?', choices: ['✍️ BÀI MẪU: "The Photography Basics session begins at ten AM and is held in Room 101."', '🎯 Tip: Câu Q7-9 có tài liệu cho sẵn. Không cần thêm quan điểm cá nhân — chỉ trả lời từ thông tin có sẵn.'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Q7-9 (Information-based): Đọc lịch trình nhanh trong 30 giây chuẩn bị. Can you tell me what activities are scheduled between lunch and the panel discussion?', translated: 'Q8: Những hoạt động nào được lên lịch giữa bữa trưa và phiên thảo luận?', choices: ['✍️ BÀI MẪU: "After the networking lunch at twelve-thirty, there is a Creative Writing Workshop in the Library, which runs from two PM. This is followed by the Panel Discussion on Careers in Creative Industries, held in the Main Hall starting at three-thirty PM."', '🎯 Tip: Q8 hỏi về nhiều mục → cần liệt kê theo thứ tự.
