What would you recommend from the schedule, and when does it start?', translated: 'Q9: Bạn có thể đề xuất từ lịch trình điều gì liên quan đến digital marketing không?', choices: ['✍️ BÀI MẪU: "Based on your interest, I\'d recommend the Social Media Marketing session, which starts at eleven AM and is held in Room 203. This session directly addresses online presence and marketing strategies, which aligns with what you\'re looking for."', '🎯 Tip: Q9 thường yêu cầu "recommend" → locate relevant item + explain relevance briefly. Không cần liệt kê tất cả — chỉ mục phù hợp nhất.'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Q9 Recommend: Identify most relevant item → state time & location → brief reason why it matches the interest.' }, // Question 10: Propose a solution { text: 'Q10 (Đề xuất giải pháp – 30 giây chuẩn bị, 60 giây nói): You will hear a voicemail message. [VOICEMAIL — Kevin Park, Conference Organiser]: "Hi, this is Kevin Park calling about the Regional Business Conference scheduled for this coming Friday. We have a significant problem — the keynote speaker, Dr. Elena Vasquez, has just informed us that she has a medical emergency and cannot attend. The conference starts in three days, and her ninety-minute slot is now completely empty. We need an alternative solution urgently. Please call me back with any suggestions you have."', translated: 'Q10: Diễn giả hội nghị chính bị bệnh và không thể tham dự. Đề xuất giải pháp.', choices: ['✍️ BÀI MẪU BAND 9 (60 giây): "Kevin, thank you for reaching out — I completely understand the urgency. I have two concrete suggestions that could resolve this effectively within your timeline. First, consider pivoting to a panel discussion format. Rather than a single keynote presenter, invite three or four senior professionals from your existing attendee or sponsor list to participate in a structured roundtable on the conference theme. This format is actually highly engaging for audiences and can be organised within forty-eight hours. I can help draft the invitation emails today if needed. Alternatively, if you already have Dr. Vasquez\'s prepared slides, consider whether she could deliver her keynote virtually via video conferencing. Many conference organisers have moved to hybrid formats successfully, and the technology infrastructure is straightforward to set up at short notice. A live Q&A following the video presentation would maintain the interactive dimension. I\'d recommend the virtual option as the primary solution since it preserves Dr. Vasquez\'s prepared content, and the panel discussion as your backup. Would you like me to coordinate either of these immediately?"', '🎯 STRUCTURE Q10: 1. Acknowledge the problem (1 câu) → 2. Solution 1 + practical detail (2-3 câu) → 3. Solution 2 alternative (2-3 câu) → 4. Recommendation + offer to help (1-2 câu). Total: ~60 giây lưu loát.'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Q10 (Propose solution): Đây là câu khó nhất. Không xin lỗi quá nhiều — đi thẳng vào 2 giải pháp cụ thể với chi tiết thực tế. Kết thúc bằng hỏi xác nhận.' }, // Question 11: Express an opinion { text: 'Q11 (Bày tỏ quan điểm – 30 giây chuẩn bị, 60 giây nói): Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? "Companies should allow employees to choose their own working hours." Give specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.', translated: 'Q11: Bạn đồng ý hay không đồng ý: "Doanh nghiệp nên cho phép nhân viên tự chọn giờ làm việc." Hãy đưa ra lý do và ví dụ cụ thể.', choices: ['✍️ BÀI MẪU BAND 9 (60 giây): "I strongly agree that companies should offer flexible working hours, and I believe the evidence for this position is now substantial. Research from Stanford University found that employees who work flexible schedules report twenty-three percent higher job satisfaction and demonstrate measurably lower absenteeism. This directly benefits employers through improved retention and reduced recruitment costs. From a practical standpoint, different people are genuinely most productive at different times. Early risers may produce their best analytical work between six and nine AM, while others peak creatively in the evening. Rigid nine-to-five schedules may actually suppress peak productivity by forcing employees to perform complex tasks during their biological low points. Of course, flexible hours require clear deliverable-based accountability frameworks — the focus must shift from hours-present to work-completed. Companies like Microsoft Japan and Unilever have successfully implemented this model with significant productivity gains. Ultimately, I believe inflexible working hours are an anachronism in knowledge-based economies where output quality matters far more than physical presence."', '🎯 STRUCTURE Q11: 1. Clear position (Agree/Disagree + strongly/partially) → 2. Reason 1 + evidence/statistic → 3. Reason 2 + example → 4. Acknowledge counterargument (optional but impressive) → 5. Restate conclusion. Total: ~7-8 câu, 60 giây.'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Q11 Opinion: Đưa ra lập trường RÕ RÀNG ngay câu đầu. Dùng số liệu hoặc ví dụ thực tế. Kết thúc bằng tổng kết lập luận. Tránh "I think both sides have good points" — thiếu dứt khoát.' } ] }, // =========================================================== // ETS 2024 TEST 1 – FULL WRITING (3 BÀI) // =========================================================== 'TOEIC Actual Test ETS 2024 · Test 1 – Full Writing (3 Bài)': { type: 'writing', questions: [ { text: 'TOEIC Writing Task 1 – Write a sentence based on a picture (5 phút): Write ONE sentence that describes the main action or situation in the photograph. [Photo: A woman is presenting data on a screen at the front of a conference room. Several colleagues are taking notes and listening attentively.]', translated: 'Task 1: Viết MỘT câu mô tả hành động chính trong bức ảnh (phòng họp có người thuyết trình và đồng nghiệp lắng nghe).', choices: [ '✍️ BÀI MẪU BAND 9: "A woman is presenting data analysis findings to her colleagues in a conference room, while the attendees take notes and listen attentively." [ĐẠT: Chủ ngữ rõ ràng + hành động chính + chi tiết bổ sung + while clause phụ]', '✍️ BÀI MẪU BAND 7: "A woman is showing information to people in a meeting room while they write things down." [CẢI THIỆN: Thêm cụm từ chi tiết hơn thay vì "information/things"]', '🎯 TIÊU CHÍ TASK 1: Một câu hoàn chỉnh (subject + verb + object/complement), mô tả đúng hành động chính, ngữ pháp chính xác, từ vựng phù hợp. Câu có thêm while clause hoặc participial phrase = điểm cao hơn.' ], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Task 1 (Sentence): 1 câu hoàn chỉnh, mô tả main action = core activity đang diễn ra. Không cần mô tả mọi chi tiết. Band 8-9: câu có cấu trúc phức.' }, { text: 'TOEIC Writing Task 2 – Respond to a written request (10 phút): Read the email and write a response of 100–150 words. [EMAIL FROM: Sarah Mitchell TO: You DATE: October 14, 2024 SUBJECT: Request for meeting] "Hi, I am Sarah Mitchell, Partnership Development Manager at GreenTech Solutions. We have been reviewing your company\'s sustainability initiatives and believe there may be a strong synergy between our organisations. I\'d like to schedule a thirty-minute video call to explore potential collaboration opportunities. Could you suggest two or three dates and times that would work for you in the next two weeks? Also, could you let me know who else from your team might attend? Thank you, Sarah"', translated: 'Task 2: Phản hồi email từ Sarah Mitchell — đề xuất thời gian họp và người tham dự.', choices: [ '✍️ BÀI MẪU BAND 8-9 (135 từ): "Dear Sarah, Thank you for reaching out and for your kind interest in our sustainability initiatives. We would be delighted to explore potential collaboration opportunities with GreenTech Solutions. Please find below three available times for our call: Monday, October 21 at 2:00 PM (GMT+7); Wednesday, October 23 at 10:00 AM (GMT+7); Friday, October 25 at 3:00 PM (GMT+7). Any of these slots would work well on our end. Regarding attendees, I would be joined by our Sustainability Director, Mr. James Park, and our Head of Corporate Partnerships, Dr. Linh Nguyen. Together, we cover both the strategic and operational dimensions of our sustainability programme. Please let me know which date and time suits you best, and I will send a calendar invitation with the video conferencing link promptly. We look forward to connecting. Best regards, [Your Name]" (135 từ)', '📋 CẤU TRÚC EMAIL PHẢN HỒI BAND 8+: Para 1 (2 câu): Cảm ơn + bày tỏ sự quan tâm. Para 2 (3-4 câu): Đề xuất 3 khung giờ cụ thể. Para 3 (2-3 câu): Liệt kê người tham dự + vai trò của họ. Para 4 (1-2 câu): Kêu gọi hành động (CTA) + kết thúc lịch sự.', '🎯 Từ vựng email chuyên nghiệp: "Thank you for reaching out" — "would be delighted to" — "Please find below" — "on our end" — "Regarding attendees" — "cover both the strategic and operational dimensions" — "promptly"' ], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Task 2: Email phải trả lời ĐẦY ĐỦ TẤT CẢ câu hỏi trong email gốc (suggested times + attendees). Thiếu một câu hỏi = giảm điểm đáng kể.' }, { text: 'TOEIC Writing Task 3 – Write an opinion essay (30 phút – 200–300 từ): Do you agree or disagree with the following statement: "Remote work is more beneficial for companies than traditional office-based work." Use specific reasons and examples to support your position.', translated: 'Task 3: Essay quan điểm: "Làm việc từ xa có lợi hơn cho doanh nghiệp so với làm việc truyền thống tại văn phòng." Bạn đồng ý hay không đồng ý?', choices: [ '✍️ BÀI MẪU BAND 8 (270 từ): "The question of whether remote work benefits companies more than traditional office arrangements has become one of the defining business debates of the post-pandemic era. While remote work offers genuine advantages, I believe its net impact on companies depends fundamentally on organisational culture, role type, and workforce composition — making a blanket preference for either model insufficient. Remote work demonstrably reduces overhead costs. A Stanford University study found that companies allowing remote work saw a thirteen percent productivity increase per employee, while simultaneously reducing office space expenditure by up to thirty percent for fully distributed teams. For knowledge-based roles — software development, data analysis, content creation — the evidence suggests remote workers frequently outperform their office-based peers, owing to reduced commuting fatigue and greater autonomy over their work environment. However, remote work presents measurable challenges that companies must not underestimate. Creative industries and early-career employees particularly benefit from the informal knowledge transfer, mentorship opportunities, and spontaneous collaboration that physical proximity naturally generates. A 2022 Microsoft Work Trend Index found that seventy-three percent of managers reported reduced confidence in their ability to monitor productivity and maintain team cohesion in fully remote settings. In conclusion, rather than characterising remote work as universally more beneficial, I believe the most effective companies are those that strategically deploy hybrid models: mandating in-person collaboration for creative, relationship-intensive work while permitting remote arrangements for focused individual tasks. This contextually intelligent approach harnesses the strengths of both modalities." (270 từ)', '📋 CẤU TRÚC ESSAY TOEIC WRITING TASK 3 BAND 8: Para 1 (Introduction 40-50 từ): Paraphrase đề + Thesis statement rõ ràng. Para 2 (Agree side 70-80 từ): 2 lý do ủng hộ + ví dụ/số liệu. Para 3 (Disagree/Nuance 70-80 từ): Hạn chế + bằng chứng. Para 4 (Conclusion 30-40 từ): Tổng kết lập trường + giải pháp/nhận xét cuối.', '🎯 Từ vựng essay chuyên nghiệp: "The defining business debate" — "demonstrably reduces" — "net impact" — "knowledge-based roles" — "blanket preference" — "contextually intelligent approach" — "deploy hybrid models" — "harnesses the strengths"' ], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Task 3 TOEIC Writing: 200-300 từ, 4 đoạn rõ ràng. Thesis Statement phải nêu lập trường của bạn trong câu cuối của đoạn giới thiệu. Band 8: có số liệu, ví dụ thực tế, từ vựng học thuật.' } ] }, // =========================================================== // ETS 2024 TEST 2 – FULL LISTENING (25 CÂU - SHORTER AUDIO DESC) // =========================================================== 'TOEIC Actual Test ETS 2024 · Test 2 – Full Listening (25 Câu)': { type: 'audio_mcq', audioTitle: 'ETS TOEIC 2024 Test 2 – Official Listening (North American Accent, Speed 1.0x)', audioScript: `PART 1 (Q1-6): Six photographs depicting various workplace and public scenarios. [Photo 1]: Workers are installing solar panels on a rooftop. [Photo 2]: A receptionist is greeting a visitor in a hotel lobby. [Photo 3]: Two people are loading boxes into a delivery van. [Photo 4]: A chef is preparing food in a restaurant kitchen. [Photo 5]: Commuters are waiting on a train platform. [Photo 6]: A woman is examining documents at her desk using a magnifying glass. PART 2 (Q7-13): Seven question-response exchanges. Q7: Have the meeting minutes been distributed to all team members? Q8: Why was the quarterly presentation postponed? Q9: Where did you find the updated product catalogue? Q10: Isn't Mr. Yamamoto joining us for the strategy session? Q11: Could someone help me set up the new printer? Q12: Should we order additional supplies now or wait until next month? Q13: How long has the company been operating this branch office? PART 3 (Q14-22): Three workplace conversations. CONV 1: Negotiating conference venue booking and catering requirements. CONV 2: Discussing product recall procedures and customer communication strategy. CONV 3: Arranging business travel itinerary, hotel upgrades, and visa requirements. PART 4 (Q23-25): Internal HR announcement about new performance review cycle and bonus structure.`, questions: [ { text: 'Q1: What are the workers doing in the photograph?', translated: 'Công nhân đang làm gì trong bức ảnh?', choices: ['Repairing a damaged roof', 'Installing solar panels on a rooftop', 'Cleaning the exterior of a building', 'Inspecting electrical wiring on a roof'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Workers are installing solar panels on a rooftop." — Hành động lắp đặt (installing) là từ khoá.' }, { text: 'Q2: What is the receptionist doing?', translated: 'Lễ tân đang làm gì?', choices: ['Checking in a guest at the hotel reception', 'Answering a phone call at the front desk', 'Greeting a visitor in the hotel lobby', 'Providing a room key to a departing guest'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"A receptionist is greeting a visitor in a hotel lobby." Từ khoá: greeting (chào đón), visitor (khách), lobby (sảnh).' }, { text: 'Q3: What are the two people doing?', translated: 'Hai người đang làm gì?', choices: ['Unloading boxes from a delivery van', 'Loading boxes into a delivery van', 'Sorting packages by size on the pavement', 'Inspecting delivery items outside a warehouse'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Two people are loading boxes into a delivery van." Loading (chất hàng lên) ≠ unloading (dỡ hàng xuống). Đây là câu bẫy phổ biến trong TOEIC Part 1.' }, { text: 'Q4: What is the chef doing?', translated: 'Đầu bếp đang làm gì?', choices: ['Serving food to customers at a table', 'Washing dishes in the kitchen sink', 'Preparing food in a restaurant kitchen', 'Presenting a new dish to restaurant staff'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"A chef is preparing food in a restaurant kitchen." Từ khoá: preparing (chuẩn bị), restaurant kitchen (bếp nhà hàng).' }, { text: 'Q5: Where are the commuters waiting?', translated: 'Hành khách đang đợi ở đâu?', choices: ['At a bus terminal near downtown', 'In a taxi queue outside an airport', 'On a train platform', 'At a ferry terminal on the waterfront'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"Commuters are waiting on a train platform." Platform (sân ga tàu) là từ khoá để phân biệt với bus stop hay airport.' }, { text: 'Q6: What is the woman doing with the documents?', translated: 'Người phụ nữ đang làm gì với các tài liệu?', choices: ['Signing her name at the bottom of a contract', 'Sorting documents into separate folders', 'Examining documents using a magnifying glass', 'Shredding confidential documents in the office'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"A woman is examining documents at her desk using a magnifying glass." Từ khoá: examining (kiểm tra kỹ), magnifying glass (kính lúp).' }, { text: 'Q7: Have the meeting minutes been distributed to all team members?', translated: 'Biên bản cuộc họp đã được phân phát cho tất cả thành viên nhóm chưa?', choices: ["Yes, I'll send them right after this call", 'The meeting was very productive', "Actually, I haven't received my copy yet"], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Câu hỏi Yes/No question về việc đã làm xong chưa → A tự nhiên nhất: xác nhận sẽ gửi. C là valid nhưng là quan điểm của người nhận, không phải người gửi.' }, { text: 'Q8: Why was the quarterly presentation postponed?', translated: 'Tại sao bài trình bày quý bị hoãn?', choices: ['Because the presenter had a scheduling conflict', 'The presentation was very successful', 'It will be held in the main conference room'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"Why" → cần lý do (reason). A cung cấp lý do cụ thể. B là nhận xét, C là địa điểm — không trả lời "why".' }, { text: 'Q9: Where did you find the updated product catalogue?', translated: 'Bạn tìm thấy danh mục sản phẩm cập nhật ở đâu?', choices: ['It was posted on the company intranet', 'The catalogue looks great this year', 'Product design sent it last Tuesday'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"Where" → địa điểm hoặc nguồn. A (intranet) = nguồn → phù hợp. C (who) không phải "where."' }, { text: "Q10: Isn't Mr. Yamamoto joining us for the strategy session?", translated: 'Không phải ông Yamamoto tham gia buổi chiến lược cùng chúng ta sao?', choices: ['He mentioned his strategy earlier', "He won't be available — he's presenting at the Tokyo summit", 'The strategy session starts at two'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Tag question → A/B xác nhận hay phủ nhận. B cung cấp lý do tại sao không tham gia — phản hồi tự nhiên nhất.' }, { text: 'Q11: Could someone help me set up the new printer?', translated: 'Ai có thể giúp tôi thiết lập máy in mới không?', choices: ['The printer is on the third floor', "Sure, I'll be right over", 'We already ordered a new printer'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Request for help (Could someone...) → tự nhiên nhất là B: "Sure, I\'ll be right over" (đồng ý giúp + cam kết hành động cụ thể).' }, { text: 'Q12: Should we order additional supplies now or wait until next month?', translated: 'Chúng ta có nên đặt hàng thêm vật tư ngay bây giờ hay đợi đến tháng sau?', choices: ['The supply room is on the second floor', "Let's go ahead and order now — inventory is getting low", 'I placed the order two weeks ago'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Or question (A or B?) → trả lời bằng lựa chọn rõ ràng. B chọn rõ "order now" và đưa ra lý do. A (địa điểm) và C (quá khứ) đều không liên quan.' }, { text: 'Q13: How long has the company been operating this branch office?', translated: 'Công ty đã vận hành chi nhánh này bao lâu rồi?', choices: ['The branch is located in Singapore', 'For about twelve years, since 2012', 'The head office is in New York'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"How long" → cần khoảng thời gian. B: "For about twelve years, since 2012" = trả lời đúng dạng. A và C đều cung cấp địa điểm, không phải thời gian.' }, { text: 'Q14: What is the primary purpose of Conversation 1 between the hotel and the event planner?', translated: 'Mục đích chính của cuộc trò chuyện 1 giữa khách sạn và người tổ chức sự kiện là gì?', choices: ['To negotiate the conference venue booking and catering requirements', 'To discuss complaint about previous event service quality', 'To arrange a hotel room reservation for the organiser', 'To plan the entertainment schedule for the conference'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Cuộc hội thoại 1: "Negotiating conference venue booking and catering requirements" — Đàm phán về đặt phòng hội nghị và yêu cầu phục vụ ăn uống.' }, { text: 'Q15: In Conversation 1, which of the following would the event planner most likely ask about?', translated: 'Trong Cuộc hội thoại 1, người tổ chức sự kiện nhiều khả năng sẽ hỏi về điều gì?', choices: ['The hotel room cancellation policy', 'Catering menu options and dietary accommodation for conference guests', 'The hotel\'s wifi password for personal use', 'Historical background of the hotel venue'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Yêu cầu phục vụ ăn uống (catering requirements) bao gồm menu và chế độ ăn đặc biệt là câu hỏi tự nhiên nhất trong ngữ cảnh đặt tiệc hội nghị.' }, { text: 'Q16: What issue is being discussed in Conversation 2?', translated: 'Vấn đề nào đang được thảo luận trong Cuộc hội thoại 2?', choices: ['Launching a new product to replace an existing one', 'Product recall procedures and customer communication strategy', 'Addressing negative reviews on the company website', 'Updating the product packaging design'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Cuộc hội thoại 2: "Discussing product recall procedures and customer communication strategy."' }, { text: 'Q17: In Conversation 2, why would a company communicate urgently with customers?', translated: 'Trong Cuộc hội thoại 2, tại sao công ty sẽ giao tiếp khẩn cấp với khách hàng?', choices: ['To announce a major product discount event', 'To notify them of a product recall and safety concern', 'To inform them of changes to the customer loyalty program', 'To survey customer satisfaction with recent purchases'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Product recall = thu hồi sản phẩm vì vấn đề an toàn → thông báo khẩn cấp cho khách hàng về recall là mục đích chính.' }, { text: 'Q18: What is the main topic of Conversation 3?', translated: 'Chủ đề chính của Cuộc hội thoại 3 là gì?', choices: ['A dispute between two colleagues about travel reimbursement', 'Arranging business travel itinerary, hotel upgrades, and visa requirements', 'Reviewing the company\'s corporate travel policy handbook', 'Booking recreational travel for the annual company retreat'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Cuộc hội thoại 3: "Arranging business travel itinerary, hotel upgrades, and visa requirements."' }, { text: 'Q19: In Conversation 3, what does the traveller likely request from the travel coordinator?', translated: 'Trong Cuộc hội thoại 3, người đi công tác nhiều khả năng yêu cầu điều gì từ người điều phối du lịch?', choices: ['Extension of the business trip by one additional week', 'Hotel room upgrade and assistance with visa documentation', 'Refund for a previously cancelled flight ticket', 'Transfer to a different departure airport'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Hotel upgrades, and visa requirements" → yêu cầu nâng hạng phòng và hỗ trợ thủ tục visa là nội dung trung tâm của conversation 3.' }, { text: 'Q20: In Conversation 3, what documentation might the business traveller need to prepare?', translated: 'Trong Cuộc hội thoại 3, người đi công tác có thể cần chuẩn bị tài liệu nào?', choices: ['Employment contract for immigration purposes', 'Visa application and supporting business documents', 'Tax identification certificate for customs clearance', 'Medical insurance documentation for overseas travel'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Visa requirements" trong ngữ cảnh business travel = visa application + business invitation letter/supporting documents.' }, { text: 'Q21: What type of business travel activity is likely discussed in Conversation 3?', translated: 'Loại hoạt động du lịch công tác nào có thể được thảo luận trong Cuộc hội thoại 3?', choices: ['Domestic conference attendance within the same country', 'International business travel to a foreign client location', 'Team-building retreat to a mountain resort', 'Training programme at company headquarters in the capital'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Visa requirements" cho thấy đây là chuyến đi quốc tế (international travel) — thị thực chỉ cần khi vượt biên quốc tế.' }, { text: 'Q22: Based on Conversation 3 context, who is most likely the travel coordinator?', translated: 'Dựa trên ngữ cảnh Cuộc hội thoại 3, ai có khả năng là người điều phối du lịch?', choices: ['A visa officer at the embassy', 'An HR or administrative professional managing corporate travel', 'The CEO\'s personal assistant scheduling executive travel', 'An airline customer service representative'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Travel coordinators in TOEIC conversations are typically HR or administrative staff who handle corporate travel bookings, hotel arrangements, and documentation.' }, { text: 'Q23 (Talk): What is the main subject of the HR announcement?', translated: 'Chủ đề chính của thông báo nhân sự là gì?', choices: ['A new employee benefits package', 'Updated performance review cycle and bonus structure', 'Changes to the company pension plan', 'Mandatory training programme schedule for the coming quarter'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Internal HR announcement about new performance review cycle and bonus structure" — đây là chủ đề trung tâm của bài thuyết trình.' }, { text: 'Q24 (Talk): What change to the performance review process is most likely being announced?', translated: 'Thay đổi nào trong quy trình đánh giá hiệu suất có khả năng được thông báo nhất?', choices: ['Replacing annual reviews with quarterly performance check-ins', 'Eliminating all written performance evaluations going forward', 'Combining the performance review and salary negotiation into one meeting', 'Outsourcing performance management to an external consulting firm'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Changing from annual to quarterly review cycle is the most common HR performance management update in TOEIC listening scenarios, aligning with "new performance review cycle" language.' }, { text: 'Q25 (Talk): Regarding the bonus structure, what information would be MOST useful for employees to know?', translated: 'Liên quan đến cấu trúc thưởng, thông tin nào SẼ HỮU ÍCH NHẤT cho nhân viên biết?', choices: ['The name of the new HR software system being implemented', 'How performance ratings will be linked to bonus calculations', 'Which departments will receive the largest bonuses', 'When the HR director will be available for individual meetings'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Nhân viên quan tâm nhất đến cách điểm đánh giá hiệu suất (performance ratings) được kết nối với tính toán thưởng (bonus calculations). Đây là thông tin thiết thực nhất.' } ] }, // =========================================================== // ETS 2024 TEST 2 – FULL READING (24 CÂU) // =========================================================== 'TOEIC Actual Test ETS 2024 · Test 2 – Full Reading (24 Câu)': { type: 'reading_passage', passageTitle: 'ETS TOEIC 2024 – Full Reading Test 2: Grammar, Text Completion & Comprehension', passageText: `PART 5 – INCOMPLETE SENTENCES (Q1-Q10) Q1: Before the contract ------- signed, both parties must review all terms and conditions carefully. (A) is (B) was (C) being (D) been Q2: The CEO's keynote address at the annual shareholders' conference was ------- well-received. (A) exceptional (B) exceptionally (C) exception (D) excepting Q3: Neither the warehouse manager ------- the logistics coordinator had been informed of the shipment delay. (A) or (B) nor (C) but (D) and Q4: The consulting firm ------- major operations in Singapore since establishing its Asia-Pacific headquarters there in 2019. (A) conducts (B) has conducted (C) conducted (D) is conducting Q5: Employees ------- submit timesheets by noon on Friday will not be included in the current payroll cycle. (A) who fail to (B) which fails to (C) that failing to (D) whom failed to Q6: The new laboratory equipment, ------- was donated by a private research foundation, significantly improved testing accuracy. (A) who (B) whose (C) which (D) that Q7: All participants are encouraged to ------- their registration confirmation emails prior to checking in at the symposium. (A) print (B) printed (C) printing (D) prints Q8: Despite ------- significant challenges in the first quarter, the project team delivered outstanding results by year-end. (A) face (B) faced (C) facing (D) to face Q9: The research ------- that consumers are more likely to purchase products endorsed by people they perceive as similar to themselves. (A) suggests (B) is suggested (C) suggested that (D) suggestion Q10: The new supplier ------- our existing vendor in terms of both price and delivery reliability. (A) outperforms (B) outperformed (C) outperforming (D) has been outperforming PART 6 – TEXT COMPLETION (Q11-Q14): BUSINESS EMAIL From: Operations Director To: All Department Heads RE: New Procurement Policy – Effective Q4 2024 Effective the first of October, all purchase orders exceeding £5,000 ------- (11) submitted to the Procurement Oversight Committee for pre-approval. This policy ------- (12) introduced in response to the findings of our annual financial audit, which identified inconsistencies in departmental spending authorisation. Going forward, all requests must include a minimum of three competitive quotes from approved vendors. Departments ------- (13) to maintain updated vendor lists, and any new vendor onboarding must comply with the revised Supplier Code of Conduct published on the company intranet. The compliance team will ------- (14) monthly spend reports to monitor adherence to the new policy. Q11: (A) must be (B) must (C) being (D) are must be Q12: (A) has been (B) have been (C) was (D) were Q13: (A) require (B) are required (C) requiring (D) required Q14: (A) review (B) reviewing (C) reviewed (D) to review PART 7 – READING COMPREHENSION (Q15-Q24) SINGLE PASSAGE (Q15-18): JOB ADVERTISEMENT POSITION: Senior Data Analyst — Consumer Insights Division COMPANY: Nexus Analytics Group LOCATION: Melbourne, Australia (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote) SALARY: AUD $105,000 – $125,000 per annum (dependent on experience) RESPONSIBILITIES: • Design and execute end-to-end quantitative research studies and consumer behaviour analyses • Build and maintain automated reporting dashboards using Tableau and Power BI • Present complex analytical findings to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders • Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Strategy teams • Mentor two junior analysts within the Consumer Insights team REQUIREMENTS: • Minimum 5 years of experience in data analytics or market research • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and R • Demonstrated experience with statistical modelling (regression, clustering, predictive analytics) • Bachelor's degree minimum; Master's degree in Statistics, Economics, or related field preferred • Experience in FMCG, retail, or financial services industry preferred HOW TO APPLY: Submit your CV and a cover letter (maximum 500 words) outlining your most significant analytical project to careers@nexusanalytics.com.au by October 31. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interview. Q15: What type of work arrangement is offered for this position? (A) Fully remote with occasional travel (B) Fully in-office at the Melbourne location (C) Hybrid with three days in-office and two days remote (D) Flexible hours with no fixed in-office requirement Q16: What is the minimum years of experience required? (A) Three years (B) Four years (C) Five years (D) Seven years Q17: Which of the following is listed as a PREFERRED but not mandatory requirement? (A) Proficiency in SQL and Python (B) A Master's degree in a relevant field (C) Experience presenting to senior leadership (D) Building dashboards in Tableau or Power BI Q18: According to the job posting, what should the cover letter include? (A) A list of all previous employers over the past decade (B) The applicant's most significant analytical project described in 500 words or fewer (C) A portfolio of all data visualisation work completed in the current role (D) References from at least two previous supervisors in data analytics DOUBLE PASSAGE (Q19-Q24): CONFERENCE INVITATION + EMAIL REPLY DOCUMENT A – INVITATION LETTER: Nexus Global Technology Forum Invitation to Present: Future of AI in Financial Services Dear Ms. Amara Okonkwo, On behalf of the organising committee of the Nexus Global Technology Forum, we are delighted to extend an invitation for you to present at our upcoming conference, to be held in Singapore from 14–16 November 2024 at the Marina Bay Convention Centre. Given your highly regarded research into machine learning applications in credit risk modelling, we believe your perspective would be of considerable value to our attendees — senior executives, regulators, and technologists from over forty countries. We invite you to present a thirty-minute keynote address on November 15 at 9:30 AM, followed by a fifteen-minute Q&A session. We are pleased to offer complimentary conference registration, economy return airfare from your home city, and four nights' accommodation at the Grand Marina Hotel. Should you accept, please confirm by October 25 at the latest. We look forward to welcoming you to Singapore. Warm regards, Dr. James Holloway Programme Director, Nexus Global Technology Forum DOCUMENT B – REPLY EMAIL: From: Amara Okonkwo To: Dr. James Holloway Date: October 23, 2024 Subject: Re: Invitation to Present – Nexus Global Technology Forum Dear Dr. Holloway, Thank you for this kind invitation. I am honoured to have been considered for such a prestigious forum. I am pleased to accept and look forward to presenting on November 15. I have one logistical request: as I will be travelling from Johannesburg, the economy return flights involve two connections and approximately twenty-two hours of travel time. Would it be possible to arrange a business class ticket for the outbound journey, given the travel demands? I am entirely comfortable with economy for the return trip. Additionally, I will require a presentation laptop with HDMI connectivity, a wireless presenter clicker, and the slides will be in PowerPoint format rather than Keynote. Please let me know if you need any additional information to complete my registration. I very much look forward to contributing to what promises to be an excellent event. Best regards, Amara Okonkwo Senior Research Fellow, FinTech Research Institute Q19: Where will the Nexus Global Technology Forum be held? (A) In Tokyo at the Tokyo International Forum (B) In Singapore at the Marina Bay Convention Centre (C) In London at the ExCeL Exhibition Centre (D) In New York at the Javits Convention Center Q20: What is Ms. Okonkwo invited to present about? (A) The history of digital banking regulation in sub-Saharan Africa (B) Machine learning applications in credit risk modelling (C) Blockchain technology in cross-border payment systems (D) Ethical considerations in AI-powered customer profiling Q21: Which of the following is NOT included in the offered package? (A) Complimentary conference registration (B) Return airfare from the speaker's home city (C) Four nights' accommodation at the Grand Marina Hotel (D) A business class upgrade for the outbound flight Q22: What special request does Ms. Okonkwo make in her reply? (A) She requests a full business class ticket for both outbound and return flights (B) She asks for a business class ticket for the outbound journey only (C) She declines the flight offer and arranges her own travel independently (D) She requests to present via video conference instead of in person Q23: What presentation equipment does Ms. Okonkwo require? (A) A Mac computer with Keynote and a laser pointer (B) A laptop with HDMI, a wireless presenter clicker, and PowerPoint compatibility (C) A large-format LED display and custom presenter podium (D) A standard projector with a VGA cable and wired microphone Q24: By what date must Ms. Okonkwo confirm her acceptance? (A) October 20 (B) October 25 (C) October 31 (D) November 1`, questions: [ // PART 5 { text: 'Q1 (Part 5): Before the contract ------- signed, both parties must review all terms.', translated: 'Trước khi hợp đồng _______ ký, cả hai bên phải xem xét tất cả các điều khoản.', choices: ['is', 'was', 'being', 'been'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"Before the contract is signed" — Present Passive trong mệnh đề trước (temporal clause). "Before" dùng với Simple Present cho conditional/temporal clauses, không phải past.' }, { text: 'Q2 (Part 5): The CEO\'s keynote address was ------- well-received.', translated: 'Bài phát biểu khai mạc của CEO _______ được tiếp nhận nồng nhiệt.', choices: ['exceptional', 'exceptionally', 'exception', 'excepting'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Exceptionally" — trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ "well-received." Cấu trúc: adverb + adjective/adverb: "exceptionally well-received." "Exceptional" là tính từ, không bổ nghĩa được cho adjective khác.' }, { text: 'Q3 (Part 5): Neither the warehouse manager ------- the logistics coordinator had been informed.', translated: 'Cả giám đốc kho lẫn _______ điều phối logistics đều không được thông báo.', choices: ['or', 'nor', 'but', 'and'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Neither... nor" là cặp liên từ tương quan chuẩn. "Neither A nor B" = "cả A lẫn B đều không." Đây là TOEIC Part 5 grammar classic.' }, { text: 'Q4 (Part 5): The consulting firm ------- major operations in Singapore since 2019.', translated: 'Công ty tư vấn _______ hoạt động lớn ở Singapore từ năm 2019.', choices: ['conducts', 'has conducted', 'conducted', 'is conducting'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"has conducted" — Present Perfect vì "since 2019" báo hiệu hành động bắt đầu từ quá khứ và tiếp tục đến hiện tại. "Since" + năm = Present Perfect là quy tắc vàng.' }, { text: 'Q5 (Part 5): Employees ------- submit timesheets by noon on Friday will not be included in payroll.', translated: 'Nhân viên _______ nộp bảng chấm công trước trưa thứ Sáu sẽ không được tính vào bảng lương hiện tại.', choices: ['who fail to', 'which fails to', 'that failing to', 'whom failed to'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"who fail to" — "Employees who fail to submit" = relative clause với "who" (người), thì hiện tại (fail) vì đây là điều kiện/chính sách hiện tại. "Whom" là tân ngữ, sai ở đây.' }, { text: 'Q6 (Part 5): The laboratory equipment, ------- was donated by a private foundation, improved testing accuracy.', translated: 'Thiết bị phòng thí nghiệm, _______ được tặng bởi một quỹ nghiên cứu tư nhân, đã cải thiện độ chính xác.', choices: ['who', 'whose', 'which', 'that'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"which" — Non-restrictive relative clause (có dấu phẩy) dùng cho vật (equipment). "That" không dùng trong non-restrictive clause, "who" cho người, "whose" là sở hữu.' }, { text: 'Q7 (Part 5): All participants are encouraged to ------- their registration confirmation emails prior to checking in.', translated: 'Tất cả người tham gia được khuyến khích _______ email xác nhận đăng ký trước khi check-in.', choices: ['print', 'printed', 'printing', 'prints'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"to print" — Cấu trúc "encouraged to + base verb (infinitive)." "Encouraged to print" = được khuyến khích in. Đây là to-infinitive sau động từ.' }, { text: 'Q8 (Part 5): Despite ------- significant challenges, the team delivered outstanding results.', translated: 'Mặc dù _______ những thách thức đáng kể, nhóm đã đạt kết quả xuất sắc.', choices: ['face', 'faced', 'facing', 'to face'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"Despite + gerund (facing)." Cấu trúc: "Despite/In spite of + V-ing" = mặc dù (đang) phải đối mặt. "Despite faced" và "despite to face" đều sai ngữ pháp.' }, { text: 'Q9 (Part 5): The research ------- that consumers prefer products endorsed by similar people.', translated: 'Nghiên cứu _______ rằng người tiêu dùng thích các sản phẩm được những người tương tự chứng thực.', choices: ['suggests', 'is suggested', 'suggested that', 'suggestion'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"suggests" — Simple Present Active. "The research suggests that..." = Nghiên cứu cho thấy rằng... "Suggested that" sẽ cần thì past, "suggestion" là danh từ.' }, { text: 'Q10 (Part 5): The new supplier ------- our existing vendor in price and delivery reliability.', translated: 'Nhà cung cấp mới _______ nhà cung cấp hiện tại của chúng tôi về giá và độ tin cậy giao hàng.', choices: ['outperforms', 'outperformed', 'outperforming', 'has been outperforming'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"outperforms" — Simple Present vì đây là sự thực hiện tại đang xảy ra (so sánh hiện tại giữa hai nhà cung cấp). Không dùng continuous vì đây là trạng thái cố định.' }, // PART 6 { text: 'Q11 (Part 6): All purchase orders exceeding £5,000 ------- submitted to the Procurement Oversight Committee.', translated: 'Tất cả đơn đặt hàng vượt quá £5,000 _______ nộp cho Ủy ban Giám sát Mua sắm.', choices: ['must be', 'must', 'being', 'are must be'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"must be" — Modal Passive: "must be submitted" (phải được nộp). "Must" + be + past participle là cấu trúc passive bắt buộc. "Are must be" sai ngữ pháp hoàn toàn.' }, { text: 'Q12 (Part 6): This policy ------- introduced in response to the annual financial audit findings.', translated: 'Chính sách này _______ được đưa ra để phản hồi với kết quả kiểm toán tài chính hằng năm.', choices: ['has been', 'have been', 'was', 'were'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"was" — Past Simple Passive vì đây là sự kiện đã hoàn thành trong quá khứ ("introduced in response to... which identified..."). Chính sách đã được giới thiệu (hoàn tất). "Policy" là danh từ số ít → was.' }, { text: 'Q13 (Part 6): Departments ------- to maintain updated vendor lists.', translated: 'Các phòng ban _______ duy trì danh sách nhà cung cấp được cập nhật.', choices: ['require', 'are required', 'requiring', 'required'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"are required" — Passive Present. "Departments are required to maintain" = các phòng ban được yêu cầu phải duy trì. "Require" (active) nghĩa là "yêu cầu ai đó" — sai context.' }, { text: 'Q14 (Part 6): The compliance team will ------- monthly spend reports to monitor adherence.', translated: 'Nhóm tuân thủ sẽ _______ các báo cáo chi tiêu hàng tháng để giám sát việc tuân thủ.', choices: ['review', 'reviewing', 'reviewed', 'to review'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"review" — "will + base verb" (Future Simple). "Will review" = sẽ xem xét. Sau "will" luôn dùng bare infinitive (review, không phải reviewing hay reviewed).' }, // PART 7 Single Passage { text: 'Q15 (Part 7): What type of work arrangement is offered for the Senior Data Analyst position?', translated: 'Loại hình làm việc nào được cung cấp cho vị trí Senior Data Analyst?', choices: ['Fully remote with occasional travel', 'Fully in-office at Melbourne', 'Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote', 'Flexible hours with no fixed requirement'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote" — stated explicitly in the job posting: "Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote."' }, { text: 'Q16 (Part 7): What is the minimum years of experience required?', translated: 'Số năm kinh nghiệm tối thiểu yêu cầu là bao nhiêu?', choices: ['Three years', 'Four years', 'Five years', 'Seven years'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"Minimum 5 years of experience in data analytics or market research."' }, { text: 'Q17 (Part 7): Which requirement is listed as PREFERRED but not mandatory?', translated: 'Yêu cầu nào được liệt kê là ƯU TIÊN nhưng không bắt buộc?', choices: ['SQL and Python proficiency', 'A Master\'s degree in a relevant field', 'Experience presenting to senior leadership', 'Building dashboards in Tableau or Power BI'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Master\'s degree in Statistics, Economics, or related field preferred" — từ "preferred" = ưu tiên nhưng không bắt buộc, khác với Bachelor\'s degree được yêu cầu ("minimum").' }, { text: 'Q18 (Part 7): What should the cover letter include?', translated: 'Thư xin việc nên bao gồm những gì?', choices: ['List of all previous employers over the past decade', 'Description of the most significant analytical project in 500 words or fewer', 'Portfolio of all data visualisation work', 'References from two previous supervisors'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Submit your CV and a cover letter (maximum 500 words) outlining your most significant analytical project."' }, // Double passage { text: 'Q19 (Part 7): Where will the Technology Forum be held?', translated: 'Diễn đàn Công nghệ sẽ được tổ chức ở đâu?', choices: ['Tokyo International Forum', 'Singapore – Marina Bay Convention Centre', 'London ExCeL Exhibition Centre', 'New York Javits Convention Center'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"to be held in Singapore from 14–16 November 2024 at the Marina Bay Convention Centre."' }, { text: 'Q20 (Part 7): What is Ms. Okonkwo invited to present about?', translated: 'Bà Okonkwo được mời trình bày về chủ đề gì?', choices: ['History of digital banking regulation', 'Machine learning applications in credit risk modelling', 'Blockchain in cross-border payments', 'AI-powered customer profiling ethics'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Given your highly regarded research into machine learning applications in credit risk modelling, we believe your perspective would be of considerable value."' }, { text: 'Q21 (Part 7): Which is NOT included in the offered package?', translated: 'Điều nào KHÔNG được bao gồm trong gói đề nghị?', choices: ['Conference registration', 'Return airfare from home city', 'Four nights accommodation', 'Business class upgrade for outbound flight'], answer: 3, ai_explain: 'The invitation offers "economy return airfare" — NOT business class. Ms. Okonkwo specifically requests a business class upgrade in her reply, confirming this was not originally included.' }, { text: 'Q22 (Part 7): What special request does Ms. Okonkwo make?', translated: 'Bà Okonkwo đưa ra yêu cầu đặc biệt nào?', choices: ['Full business class for both flights', 'Business class for outbound journey only', 'She arranges her own travel independently', 'She requests to present via video conference'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Would it be possible to arrange a business class ticket for the outbound journey, given the travel demands? I am entirely comfortable with economy for the return trip."' }, { text: 'Q23 (Part 7): What presentation equipment does Ms. Okonkwo require?', translated: 'Bà Okonkwo yêu cầu thiết bị trình bày nào?', choices: ['Mac with Keynote and laser pointer', 'Laptop with HDMI, wireless clicker, PowerPoint compatible', 'Large-format LED display and custom podium', 'Projector with VGA cable and wired microphone'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"I will require a presentation laptop with HDMI connectivity, a wireless presenter clicker, and the slides will be in PowerPoint format rather than Keynote."' }, { text: 'Q24 (Part 7): By what date must Ms. Okonkwo confirm her acceptance?', translated: 'Bà Okonkwo phải xác nhận chấp nhận trước ngày nào?', choices: ['October 20', 'October 25', 'October 31', 'November 1'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Should you accept, please confirm by October 25 at the latest."' } ] }, // =========================================================== // PRACTICE TESTS (SHORT) // =========================================================== 'TOEIC Part 1 Practice – Photograph Description': { type: 'audio_mcq', audioTitle: 'TOEIC Practice: Part 1 – Photo Description (6 questions)', audioScript: 'Six TOEIC-style photographs: 1. A man is reading a newspaper on a park bench. 2. Workers are paving a road. 3. A woman is hanging clothes on a line. 4. A conference table with laptops and papers is shown. 5. A chef is decorating a cake. 6. Boats are docked at a marina.', questions: [ { text: 'P1-1: A man is _______ on a park bench.', translated: 'P1-1: Người đàn ông đang _______ trên ghế công viên.', choices: ['sleeping soundly', 'reading a newspaper', 'feeding the ducks', 'talking on his phone'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"A man is reading a newspaper on a park bench." — Action keywords: reading, newspaper, bench. Eliminate distractors: sleeping (eyes closed), feeding ducks (near water), phone (different activity).' }, { text: 'P1-2: What are the workers doing in the road photograph?', translated: 'P1-2: Công nhân đang làm gì trong bức ảnh về đường phố?', choices: ['Directing traffic around an accident', 'Installing new road signs', 'Paving a road', 'Painting lane markings on the road'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"Workers are paving a road." Paving = trải nhựa đường. Key visual: asphalt equipment, road roller, workers in safety vests.' }, { text: 'P1-3: What is the woman doing in the laundry photograph?', translated: 'P1-3: Người phụ nữ đang làm gì trong bức ảnh giặt đồ?', choices: ['Ironing clothes on a board', 'Hanging clothes on a line', 'Sorting laundry into baskets', 'Operating a washing machine'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"A woman is hanging clothes on a line." Hanging (treo) on a line (dây phơi) = outdoor laundry. Ironing requires board/iron; sorting requires baskets visible.' }, { text: 'P1-4: What can be seen on the conference table?', translated: 'P1-4: Có thể thấy gì trên bàn phòng họp?', choices: ['Only empty chairs and glasses of water', 'Laptops and papers are spread across the table', 'A projector and presentation screen', 'Only name placards and pens'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"A conference table with laptops and papers is shown." — Key items: laptops (technology), papers (documents). No projector or people actively working.' }, { text: 'P1-5: What is the chef doing in the kitchen photograph?', translated: 'P1-5: Đầu bếp đang làm gì trong bức ảnh nhà bếp?', choices: ['Chopping vegetables on a cutting board', 'Serving a dish to a restaurant customer', 'Decorating a cake', 'Washing pots in the kitchen sink'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"A chef is decorating a cake." Decorating (trang trí) a cake = piping icing, adding fondant decorations. Visual cue: piping bag or spatula.' }, { text: 'P1-6: Where are the boats in the final photograph?', translated: 'P1-6: Thuyền ở đâu trong bức ảnh cuối?', choices: ['Racing across open water', 'Under repair in a drydock facility', 'Docked at a marina', 'Being loaded with cargo at a commercial port'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"Boats are docked at a marina." Docked (đậu bến) at a marina (bến du thuyền) = boats stationary, tied to dock. Racing = motion blur, drydock = boats out of water, cargo port = industrial setting.' } ] }, 'TOEIC Part 2 Practice – Question Response': { type: 'audio_mcq', audioTitle: 'TOEIC Practice: Part 2 – Question Response (8 exchanges)', audioScript: 'Eight question-response pairs covering WH questions (Who, What, Where, When, Why, How), Yes/No questions, and tag questions in office contexts.', questions: [ { text: 'P2-1: Who approved the budget for the new marketing campaign?', translated: 'P2-1: Ai đã phê duyệt ngân sách cho chiến dịch marketing mới?', choices: ['The budget was approved yesterday', 'Ms. Reynolds from the finance committee', 'It was a very large budget'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Who" → cần tên người hoặc chức danh. B cung cấp cả tên (Ms. Reynolds) và chức danh (finance committee). A trả lời "when", C là nhận xét chung.' }, { text: 'P2-2: What time does the webinar start?', translated: 'P2-2: Buổi hội thảo web bắt đầu lúc mấy giờ?', choices: ['At three thirty PM Eastern Standard Time', 'The webinar is about digital marketing', 'You can register on the website'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"What time" → thời gian cụ thể. A: "At three thirty PM Eastern Standard Time" = đúng format. B trả lời "what about" (topic), C trả lời "how" (how to register).' }, { text: 'P2-3: Where can I find the updated client database?', translated: 'P2-3: Tôi có thể tìm thấy cơ sở dữ liệu khách hàng cập nhật ở đâu?', choices: ['It should be on the shared server in the Sales folder', 'The database was updated last month', 'There are about 500 client records'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"Where" → địa điểm/vị trí. A: "shared server in the Sales folder" = location. B (when), C (how many) không trả lời "where."' }, { text: 'P2-4: Haven\'t you submitted your expense report yet?', translated: 'P2-4: Bạn vẫn chưa nộp báo cáo chi phí sao?', choices: ['Yes, I submitted it this morning to accounting', 'The expense report is very detailed', 'Accounting is on the second floor'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Negative question (Haven\'t you...?) → A xác nhận đã nộp rồi. "Yes, I submitted it this morning" = trả lời hành động đã hoàn thành. B và C không trả lời câu hỏi.' }, { text: 'P2-5: Could you make copies of the agenda for everyone?', translated: 'P2-5: Bạn có thể photocopy chương trình họp cho mọi người không?', choices: ['Sure, how many people are attending?', 'The agenda was set last week', 'The meeting is in Room 402'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Request (Could you...?) → A đồng ý + hỏi số lượng cần thiết = phản hồi tự nhiên và hữu ích nhất. B (when it was set) và C (where meeting is) không trả lời request.' }, { text: 'P2-6: Why was the product launch rescheduled?', translated: 'P2-6: Tại sao việc ra mắt sản phẩm bị lên lịch lại?', choices: ['The launch party was very exciting', 'Because the manufacturing team needed two more weeks for quality testing', 'The new launch date is next Thursday'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Why" → lý do (reason). B cung cấp lý do cụ thể (cần thêm 2 tuần để kiểm tra chất lượng). A là nhận xét, C là "when" (thời gian mới).' }, { text: 'P2-7: The new project timeline has been confirmed, hasn\'t it?', translated: 'P2-7: Tiến độ dự án mới đã được xác nhận rồi phải không?', choices: ['Yes, the final version was sent to all stakeholders yesterday', 'The timeline is very optimistic', 'Project management set it up'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Tag question (hasn\'t it?) → xác nhận/phủ nhận + chi tiết. A xác nhận "Yes" + thêm thông tin (sent to stakeholders yesterday). B là ý kiến, C không trả lời yes/no.' }, { text: 'P2-8: How did the sales team achieve such strong Q3 results?', translated: 'P2-8: Nhóm kinh doanh đã đạt được kết quả Q3 mạnh như vậy bằng cách nào?', choices: ['Q3 results were excellent this year', 'By focusing on high-value enterprise accounts and expanding into two new regional markets', 'The sales team has twelve members'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"How" → phương pháp/cách thức. B giải thích chiến lược cụ thể (enterprise accounts + 2 new regional markets). A là nhận xét, C là thông tin về team (không phải cách thức).' } ] }, 'TOEIC Part 3 Practice – Short Conversations': { type: 'audio_mcq', audioTitle: 'TOEIC Practice: Part 3 – Short Conversations (3 conversations × 3 questions)', audioScript: `CONVERSATION 1 – REQUESTING A MEETING ROOM: Receptionist: Good afternoon. Can I help you? Employee (Mark): Hi. I need to book Conference Room B for a client presentation this Thursday at two PM. It's for about ten people and we'll need the projector. Receptionist: Let me check... Thursday at two PM, Conference Room B. I'm afraid that room is already booked until four PM on Thursday. I do have Conference Room A available — it's slightly smaller, capacity for eight, but it has both a projector and a video conferencing system. Mark: Hmm, we definitely need space for ten. Is there anything else available? Receptionist: I can check the training room on the fourth floor — it holds fifteen and has a full AV setup, including wireless presentation capability. Mark: That sounds perfect. Please book it under Mark Chen in the Sales department. I'll confirm the exact attendee count by Wednesday. Receptionist: Done. I'll send you a confirmation email within the hour. CONVERSATION 2 – PRODUCT COMPLAINT CALL: Customer Service (Lisa): Thank you for calling TechVision support, this is Lisa. Customer (Mr. Webb): Hello. I purchased your WV-500 wireless headphones three weeks ago and the battery started failing after just five days. I've already tried the reset procedure from your website, but the problem persists. Lisa: I'm sorry to hear that, Mr. Webb. Three weeks is definitely within our ninety-day return and replacement policy. I can offer you a full replacement unit or, if you prefer, a full refund to your original payment method. Customer: I'd prefer a replacement — I like the product when it works. How long will delivery take? Lisa: Standard delivery is three to five business days, but since this is a warranty replacement I can upgrade you to express shipping at no additional charge — you should receive the unit within two business days. Customer: That's great. Will I need to return the faulty unit first? Lisa: No, we'll send the replacement first. Once you receive it, we'll include a prepaid return label for the defective unit. CONVERSATION 3 – BUSINESS TRAVEL BOOKING: Travel Coordinator (Helen): Helen speaking, corporate travel. Manager (Ms. Park): Hi Helen, I need to book travel to Tokyo for a client meeting on November 12th. I'll need to arrive the evening before. Helen: Certainly. Departing from where? Ms. Park: From Singapore Changi. And I'd like to request a business class seat if there's one available within the travel budget. Helen: Let me check... Singapore to Tokyo on November 11th, business class. I have a Singapore Airlines departure at 6:45 PM arriving Tokyo Haneda at 1:50 AM local time. That would be within your travel budget. Ms. Park: Perfect. And hotel — somewhere close to Shibuya, preferably with a gym. Helen: The Park Hyatt Tokyo in Shinjuku is close to Shibuya and excellent — I can also check the Andaz. Both are within policy. Ms. Park: Let's go with the Park Hyatt. And can you arrange an airport transfer from Haneda? Helen: Absolutely. I'll include a private car transfer. What time does your meeting end on the 12th? Ms. Park: Probably around six PM. I'll book my return for the 13th.`, questions: [ { text: 'P3-1: Why does Mark contact the receptionist?', translated: 'P3-1: Tại sao Mark liên hệ với lễ tân?', choices: ['To report a broken projector in Conference Room B', 'To book a conference room for a client presentation', 'To cancel an existing room reservation for Thursday', 'To request the IT team to set up video conferencing equipment'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"I need to book Conference Room B for a client presentation this Thursday at two PM."' }, { text: 'P3-2: Why is Conference Room B not available?', translated: 'P3-2: Tại sao Phòng Họp B không có sẵn?', choices: ['It is undergoing maintenance and cleaning', 'It has already been booked until 4 PM on Thursday', 'The room capacity has been reduced due to safety regulations', 'It does not have the required projector equipment'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"I\'m afraid that room is already booked until four PM on Thursday."' }, { text: 'P3-3: What is Mark\'s response to the alternative room suggestion?', translated: 'P3-3: Phản ứng của Mark với gợi ý phòng thay thế là gì?', choices: ['He agrees to use the smaller Conference Room A with 8 capacity', 'He books the training room on the fourth floor which holds 15', 'He decides to postpone the presentation to another day', 'He asks for a room outside the building at an external venue'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"That sounds perfect. Please book it under Mark Chen in the Sales department." — Mark chọn phòng huấn luyện tầng 4 vì cần chỗ cho 10 người.' }, { text: 'P3-4: How long has Mr. Webb had the WV-500 headphones?', translated: 'P3-4: Ông Webb đã có tai nghe WV-500 được bao lâu?', choices: ['5 days', '10 days', '3 weeks', '90 days'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"I purchased your WV-500 wireless headphones three weeks ago." = 3 tuần. Lưu ý: battery failed after just 5 days (5 ngày pin hỏng), nhưng thời gian sở hữu là 3 tuần.' }, { text: 'P3-5: What does Mr. Webb choose instead of a full refund?', translated: 'P3-5: Ông Webb chọn gì thay vì hoàn tiền đầy đủ?', choices: ['A partial store credit toward a newer model', 'A full replacement unit of the WV-500', 'An extended warranty for his current headphones', 'Free repair service at a local service centre'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"I\'d prefer a replacement — I like the product when it works."' }, { text: 'P3-6: How soon will Mr. Webb receive the replacement unit?', translated: 'P3-6: Khi nào ông Webb sẽ nhận được sản phẩm thay thế?', choices: ['Within 24 hours via same-day courier', 'Within 2 business days via express shipping', 'Within 3 to 5 business days standard delivery', 'Within 7 business days international shipping'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"I can upgrade you to express shipping at no additional charge — you should receive the unit within two business days."' }, { text: 'P3-7: What class of travel does Ms. Park request?', translated: 'P3-7: Ms. Park yêu cầu hạng ghế nào?', choices: ['Economy class with extra legroom', 'Premium economy class', 'Business class', 'First class'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"I\'d like to request a business class seat if there\'s one available within the travel budget."' }, { text: 'P3-8: Which hotel does Ms. Park ultimately choose?', translated: 'P3-8: Ms. Park cuối cùng chọn khách sạn nào?', choices: ['Andaz Tokyo Toranomon Hills', 'Hilton Tokyo near Shinjuku Station', 'Park Hyatt Tokyo in Shinjuku', 'Grand Hyatt Tokyo in Roppongi'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"Let\'s go with the Park Hyatt." — Ms. Park chọn Park Hyatt Tokyo sau khi được Helen đề xuất hai lựa chọn.' }, { text: 'P3-9: What additional service does Ms. Park request?', translated: 'P3-9: Ms. Park yêu cầu dịch vụ bổ sung nào?', choices: ['A private Japanese language interpreter for the client meeting', 'An airport transfer from Haneda to the hotel', 'A restaurant reservation for the client dinner on November 12th', 'A meeting room booking at the Tokyo client office'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"And can you arrange an airport transfer from Haneda?" — Helen xác nhận: "Absolutely. I\'ll include a private car transfer."' } ] }, 'TOEIC Part 5 Practice – Incomplete Sentences': { type: 'reading_passage', passageTitle: 'TOEIC Part 5 Practice: Incomplete Sentences (Grammar & Vocabulary – 10 Câu)', passageText: `TOEIC PART 5 PRACTICE – 10 INCOMPLETE SENTENCES Q1: All team members ------- to attend the mandatory safety training next Wednesday. (A) require (B) are required (C) requiring (D) required Q2: The proposal ------- by the board before it can be forwarded to the client. (A) must approve (B) must be approved (C) must approving (D) must approved Q3: Our company has experienced ------- growth in the Asia-Pacific market over the past two years. (A) exception (B) exceptionally (C) exceptional (D) excepted Q4: Please ------- your visitor badge visibly at all times while on company premises. (A) wearing (B) wore (C) wear (D) worn Q5: The project was completed ------- schedule, much to the delight of the entire management team. (A) ahead of (B) instead of (C) in spite of (D) due to Q6: ------- the heavy rainfall, the outdoor product demonstration was cancelled and rescheduled for the following week. (A) Despite (B) Due to (C) Although (D) Even though Q7: The finance department ------- the annual budget projections since early September. (A) prepared (B) prepares (C) has been preparing (D) will prepare Q8: Employees ------- work more than forty hours per week are entitled to overtime compensation under company policy. (A) who (B) which (C) whose (D) whom Q9: The new accounts software is both user-friendly ------- highly compatible with our existing infrastructure. (A) but also (B) and (C) nor (D) or Q10: Please submit all documentation ------- the specified deadline to ensure timely processing of your application. (A) in spite of (B) prior to (C) in lieu of (D) instead of`, questions: [ { text: 'Q1: All team members ------- to attend the mandatory safety training.', translated: 'Q1: Tất cả thành viên nhóm _______ tham dự đào tạo an toàn bắt buộc.', choices: ['require', 'are required', 'requiring', 'required'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"are required" — Passive present. "Team members are required to attend" = các thành viên được yêu cầu (bởi công ty). "Require" là active — nghĩa ngược lại.' }, { text: 'Q2: The proposal ------- before it can be forwarded to the client.', translated: 'Q2: Đề xuất _______ trước khi có thể chuyển đến khách hàng.', choices: ['must approve', 'must be approved', 'must approving', 'must approved'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"must be approved" — Modal Passive. "Must + be + past participle" là cấu trúc passive obligation. Proposal không tự phê duyệt — được phê duyệt bởi board.' }, { text: 'Q3: Our company has experienced ------- growth in the Asia-Pacific market.', translated: 'Q3: Công ty chúng tôi đã trải nghiệm sự tăng trưởng _______ tại thị trường châu Á-Thái Bình Dương.', choices: ['exception', 'exceptionally', 'exceptional', 'excepted'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"exceptional" — Tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "growth." "Exceptional growth" = tăng trưởng ngoại lệ/vượt trội. "Exceptionally" là trạng từ, không bổ nghĩa cho noun.' }, { text: 'Q4: Please ------- your visitor badge visibly at all times.', translated: 'Q4: Vui lòng _______ thẻ khách thăm của bạn một cách dễ thấy mọi lúc.', choices: ['wearing', 'wore', 'wear', 'worn'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"wear" — Imperative (mệnh lệnh thức). "Please + base verb" = yêu cầu lịch sự. "Wear" là base form. "Wearing" là gerund/present participle, không dùng sau "please" trực tiếp.' }, { text: 'Q5: The project was completed ------- schedule.', translated: 'Q5: Dự án được hoàn thành _______ lịch trình.', choices: ['ahead of', 'instead of', 'in spite of', 'due to'], answer: 0, ai_explain: '"ahead of schedule" = trước thời hạn (cụm cố định trong TOEIC). "Behind schedule" = trễ tiến độ. "Instead of schedule" và "due to schedule" đều không phải collocations tự nhiên.' }, { text: 'Q6: ------- the heavy rainfall, the outdoor demonstration was cancelled.', translated: 'Q6: _______ mưa to, buổi trình diễn ngoài trời đã bị hủy.', choices: ['Despite', 'Due to', 'Although', 'Even though'], answer: 1, ai_explain: '"Due to" + noun phrase (the heavy rainfall) = "vì/do" + danh từ. "Due to" theo sau là danh từ/noun phrase. "Although/Even though" theo sau là mệnh đề (subject + verb).' }, { text: 'Q7: The finance department ------- the annual budget projections since early September.', translated: 'Q7: Phòng tài chính _______ các dự báo ngân sách hàng năm từ đầu tháng 9.', choices: ['prepared', 'prepares', 'has been preparing', 'will prepare'], answer: 2, ai_explain: '"has been preparing" — Present Perfect Continuous. TRACKING AND REPORTING: Individual progress dashboards have been updated in the Sales Performance System (SPS). You can access your real-time ranking and projected bonus at any time. Monthly progress reviews will be conducted on the last Friday of each month — October 25, November 29, and December 27. Please contact your direct manager or HR Business Partner with any questions. THANG QUY ĐỔI ĐIỂM CHUẨN ETS (10-990) // ========================================== function calculateToeicScore(rawScore, totalQuestions, section) { if (!totalQuestions || totalQuestions === 0) totalQuestions = 25; const percentage = rawScore / totalQuestions; let scaledScore; if (section === 'Listening') { // Listening: max 495 points const levels = [5, 20, 35, 50, 70, 90, 115, 140, 165, 190, 215, 240, 265, 290, 320, 350, 385, 415, 445, 470, 495]; const idx = Math.round(percentage * (levels.length - 1)); scaledScore = levels[Math.min(idx, levels.length - 1)]; } else if (section === 'Reading') { // Reading: max 495 points const levels = [5, 15, 30, 50, 70, 95, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240, 275, 310, 340, 370, 395, 420, 445, 460, 475, 495]; const idx = Math.round(percentage * (levels.length - 1)); scaledScore = levels[Math.min(idx, levels.length - 1)]; } else { scaledScore = Math.round(percentage * 200); } const totalEstimate = scaledScore; const level = totalEstimate >= 860 ? 'C1 – Advanced Proficiency (860–990)' : totalEstimate >= 730 ? 'B2 – Upper Intermediate (730–855)' : totalEstimate >= 600 ? 'B1+ – Working Proficiency (600–725)' : totalEstimate >= 470 ? You will hear a conversation between a tourist and a tour company representative. Agent: Good morning, Blue Horizon Adventures, this is Rachel speaking. How may I help you today? Tourist: Hello. I'd like to enquire about booking a guided tour to the Limestone Caves National Park. Agent: Certainly! We have several packages available. Are you travelling alone or with a group? Tourist: It'll be just my partner and me. We're particularly interested in the geological formations. Agent: Perfect. Our most popular option is the Heritage Explorer Tour, which runs every Tuesday and Saturday morning. Tourist: What time does it start? Agent: Departure from the city centre is at eight fifteen, and we return by approximately half past four in the afternoon. Tourist: And what does the price include? Agent: The fee covers transport, a licensed guide, morning tea, and a three-course lunch at the Limestone Ridge restaurant. Tourist: That sounds wonderful. Could you also tell me what to bring? Agent: Comfortable walking shoes are essential, and we recommend wearing light layers as temperatures inside the caves can drop to around twelve degrees. Sunscreen and a hat for the outdoor segments, and please bring a water bottle — though we provide two litres per person. Oh, and a camera, of course! Tourist: What's the booking reference number for this package? Agent: Your reference code is LV-4892-B. And may I take your full name for the reservation? Tourist: It's Jonathan Ashworth. A-S-H-W-O-R-T-H. Agent: And a contact number? Tourist: 07812 334 509. Agent: How would you like to pay? We accept credit card or bank transfer. Tourist: I'll pay by credit card please. Agent: Excellent. The total for two adults is one hundred and sixty-four pounds. There's also a £10 refundable deposit required at the time of booking. SECTION 2 – MONOLOGUE: MUSEUM AUDIO GUIDE Narrator: Section 2. You will hear a museum audio guide for visitors to the National Maritime Museum. Guide: Welcome to the National Maritime Museum. Before you begin your self-guided tour, I'd like to give you a brief overview of today's highlights. The museum is divided into four themed wings. Wing A, located on the ground floor to your left, focuses on the Age of Exploration — featuring original navigation instruments, manuscripts, and a replica of Sir Francis Drake's Golden Hinde. Wing B, on the same floor but to the right, houses our interactive digital gallery where visitors can simulate ocean navigation using 15th-century celestial charts. On the first floor, Wing C presents our permanent collection of maritime art, including seascapes by J.M.W. Turner. Finally, Wing D on the first floor features temporary exhibitions; this month we have a special display on submarine warfare from 1914 to 1945. The museum café is located in the courtyard between Wings A and B and serves hot meals until three PM. The gift shop, situated near the main entrance, stocks exclusive maritime prints and replica artefacts. Guided tours depart from the main lobby at ten AM and two PM daily. Photography is permitted throughout, except in Wing D where some artefacts are on loan from international collections. Lockers for bags and coats are available near the main entrance — please use a two-pound coin which is fully refundable. We ask that all visitors switch their mobile phones to silent mode. We hope you enjoy your visit. SECTION 3 – DISCUSSION: UNIVERSITY PROJECT ON RENEWABLE ENERGY Narrator: Section 3. You will hear a conversation between two students, Maya and Tom, discussing their final-year research project. Maya: Tom, I've been reviewing our data from the solar panel efficiency tests, and I'm concerned about the inconsistencies in the morning readings. Tom: I noticed that too. I think it might be related to the orientation of the panels — our west-facing array consistently underperforms before noon. Maya: Exactly. Dr. Henderson suggested repositioning them to face south-south-west, which would maximise exposure during peak solar hours between ten and two. Tom: Should we include that in our methodology section? I mean, repositioning mid-experiment could compromise our dataset's integrity. Maya: That's a valid concern. Maybe we should keep the original array unchanged as our control group and set up a secondary adjusted array for comparative analysis. Tom: That's actually a really solid experimental design. It would let us quantify the performance differential without invalidating our existing data. Maya: I also want to address the battery storage side of things. Our current lithium-ion units are losing efficiency in cold weather — we recorded a 23% capacity reduction when temperatures dropped below eight degrees last month. Tom: Perhaps we should explore solid-state battery technology for the revised version of our project. There are several peer-reviewed papers from MIT and the University of Edinburgh we should cite. Maya: Agreed. For our presentation next Thursday, I think we should structure it as: problem identification, methodology revision, comparative results, and then our recommendations for real-world application. Tom: Don't forget we need to acknowledge funding from the university's green innovation grant — that goes in our acknowledgements slide. SECTION 4 – ACADEMIC LECTURE: DEEP-SEA ECOSYSTEM RESEARCH Narrator: Section 4. You will hear part of a university lecture on deep-sea ecology. Lecturer: Good afternoon, everyone. Today we'll be examining what scientists have recently discovered about hydrothermal vent ecosystems — arguably one of the most extraordinary biomes on our planet. Hydrothermal vents are essentially fissures in the ocean floor through which geothermally heated water escapes. They were first discovered in 1977 by researchers aboard the submersible Alvin, operating near the Galápagos Rift. What made this discovery so revolutionary was the finding that entire ecosystems could thrive in the complete absence of sunlight — a paradigm-shattering observation given that photosynthesis had long been assumed to be the universal foundation of all food chains. Instead, vent ecosystems are driven by chemosynthesis: bacteria oxidise inorganic compounds such as hydrogen sulphide to produce energy. These chemosynthetic bacteria form the base of a food web that supports remarkable organisms — giant tube worms up to two metres in length, ghostly white crabs, and eyeless shrimp that navigate using specialised heat-sensing organs. Current research is focusing on two critical areas: first, the potential pharmaceutical applications of extremophile enzymes — these enzymes function at temperatures exceeding 120 degrees Celsius and pressures three hundred times greater than at sea level, making them invaluable for industrial biotechnology. Second, vent ecosystems are informing our models of potential life on icy moons such as Europa and Enceladus, where liquid oceans may exist beneath frozen crusts.`, questions: [ // SECTION 1 (Q1-6) { text: 'What is the name of the tour package the tourist is interested in?', translated: 'Tên gói tour du lịch mà khách quan tâm là gì?', choices: ['Heritage Explorer Tour', 'Limestone Adventure Tour', 'Cave Discovery Package', 'Geological Wonder Tour'], answer: 0, ai_explain: 'Agent nói rõ: "Our most popular option is the Heritage Explorer Tour, which runs every Tuesday and Saturday morning."' }, { text: 'What time does the tour depart from the city centre?', translated: 'Tour khởi hành từ trung tâm thành phố lúc mấy giờ?', choices: ['7:45 AM', '8:15 AM', '8:30 AM', '9:00 AM'], answer: 1, ai_explain: 'Agent thông báo: "Departure from the city centre is at eight fifteen" = 8:15 AM.' }, { text: 'What is included in the tour fee?
